package definitions;

import com.deque.html.axecore.results.Results;
import io.cucumber.java.en.And;
import io.cucumber.java.en.Then;
import io.cucumber.java.en.When;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.testng.Assert;
import utils.AccessibilityUtils;

public class AccessibilitySteps {

    private Results lastScanResults;

    private WebDriver getDriver() {
        return Hooks.getDriver();
    }

    @When("User runs accessibility scan on {string}")
    public void userRunsAccessibilityScanOn(String pageName) {
        lastScanResults = AccessibilityUtils.runAccessibilityScan(getDriver(), pageName);

        // Log results into Cucumber report
        String summary = AccessibilityUtils.buildViolationSummary(lastScanResults);
        Hooks.scenario.get().log(summary);
    }

    @Then("the page should have no critical WCAG violations")
    public void thePageShouldHaveNoCriticalWCAGViolations() {
        String summary = AccessibilityUtils.buildViolationSummary(lastScanResults);
        Assert.assertFalse(
                AccessibilityUtils.hasCriticalViolations(lastScanResults),
                "Critical/Serious WCAG violations found:\n" + summary
        );
    }

    @Then("the page should have no WCAG violations")
    public void thePageShouldHaveNoWCAGViolations() {
        String summary = AccessibilityUtils.buildViolationSummary(lastScanResults);
        Assert.assertEquals(
                lastScanResults.getViolations().size(), 0,
                "WCAG violations found:\n" + summary
        );
    }

    @And("User logs all WCAG results without failing")
    public void userLogsAllWCAGResultsWithoutFailing() {
        // Soft check â€” logs everything, never fails the scenario
        String summary = AccessibilityUtils.buildViolationSummary(lastScanResults);
        Hooks.scenario.get().log(summary);
        System.out.println(summary);
    }
}

	@Given("the API endpoint is configured with {string}")
	public void theAPIEndpointIsConfiguredWith(String Endpoint) {
		endpoint = prop.getProperty("AuthHandler")+ Endpoint;
		Hooks.log("API Endpoint configured: " + endpoint);
	}

	@Given("the API Token endpoint is configured with {string}")
	public void theAPITokenEndpointIsConfiguredWith(String TokenEndpoint) {
		endpoint = prop.getProperty("AuthHandler")+ TokenEndpoint;
		Hooks.log("API Token Endpoint configured: " + endpoint);
	}

	@And("the request body is:")
	public void theRequestBodyIs(String body) {
		String claimNumber = prop.getProperty("ClaimNumber");
		String FileId = prop.getProperty("FileId");
		String LoginId = prop.getProperty("userLoginID");
		String LastName = prop.getProperty("LastName");
		String dateOfBirth = prop.getProperty("dateOfBirth");
		String Month = prop.getProperty("Month");
		String Year = prop.getProperty("Year");
		String InstitutionNumber = prop.getProperty("InstitutionNumber");
		String TransitNumber = prop.getProperty("TransitNumber");
		String BankAccountNumber = prop.getProperty("BankAccountNumber");
		String DD_publicID = prop.getProperty("DD_publicID");
		String RefNumber = prop.getProperty("RefNumber");
		String SessionID= prop.getProperty("SessionId");
		String UploadFileID= prop.getProperty("UploadFileId");
		String Filename = prop.getProperty("Filename");
		// Fetch ClaimNumber from config.properties
		requestBody = body.replace("{{ClaimNumber}}", claimNumber).replace("{{FileID}}", FileId).replace("{{userLoginID}}", LoginId)
				.replace( "{{LastName}}", LastName).replace("{{dateOfBirth}}", dateOfBirth)
				.replace("{{Month}}", Month)
				.replace("{{Year}}", Year)
				.replace("{{InstitutionNumber}}", InstitutionNumber)
				.replace("{{TransitNumber}}", TransitNumber)
				.replace("{{BankAccountNumber}}", BankAccountNumber)
				.replace("{{DD_publicID}}", DD_publicID)
				.replace("{{RefNumber}}", RefNumber)
				.replace("{{Filename}}", Filename)
				.replace("{{SessionId}}", SessionID)
				.replace("{{UploadFileId}}", UploadFileID);
		Hooks.log("Request body configured with dynamic parameters.");
	}

	@When("a POST request is sent")
	public void aPOSTRequestIsSent() {
		// Disable SSL validation
		RestAssured.useRelaxedHTTPSValidation();
		String bearerToken = prop.getProperty("BearerToken");
		Hooks.log("Sending POST request to: " + endpoint);
		response = RestAssured // Removed 'Response' keyword here
				.given()
				.log().all() // Logs the request details
				.header("Authorization", "Bearer " + bearerToken)
				.header("Content-Type", "application/json")
				.body(requestBody)
				.post(endpoint);
	}

	@Then("the response status code should be {int}")
	public void theResponseStatusCodeShouldBe(int statusCode) throws Exception {
		// Log the response details for debugging
		//response.then().log().all(); // Logs the response details
		Hooks.log("Response Pretty Print:");
		response.prettyPrint(); // Prints the response body
		assertThat(response.getStatusCode(), equalTo(statusCode));
		Hooks.log("Response status code validated: " + statusCode);
		// Capture the current timestamp

	}

	@When("a POST request is sent with form data")
	public void aPOSTRequestIsSentWithFormData() {
		String bearerToken = prop.getProperty("BearerToken");
		File file = new File(prop.getProperty("Filepath")); // Path to the file
		Hooks.log("Sending POST request with form-data to: " + endpoint);
		response = RestAssured // Removed 'Response' keyword here
				.given()
				.log().all() // Logs the request details
				.header("Authorization", "Bearer " + bearerToken)
				.header("Content-Type", "multipart/form-data")
				.multiPart("file", file) // Attach the file
				.formParam("claimId", prop.getProperty("ClaimNumber")) // Add claimId as form data
				.post(endpoint);

	}

	@Then("Extract the file id from the response")
	public void extractTheFileIdFromTheResponse() throws Exception {

		String fileId = response.jsonPath().getString("name");
		Assert.assertNotNull("File ID should not be null", fileId);
		prop.setProperty("FileId", fileId, Filepath); // Store the fileId in config.properties
		Hooks.log("Extracted File ID: " + fileId);
	}


	@When("a POST request is sent with Claimid as parameters")
	public void aPOSTRequestIsSentWithClaimidAsParameters() {
		String bearerToken = prop.getProperty("BearerToken");
		Hooks.log("Sending GET request with ClaimId parameter to: " + endpoint);
		response = RestAssured // Removed 'Response' keyword here
				.given()
				.log().all() // Logs the request details
				.header("Authorization", "Bearer " + bearerToken)
				.queryParam("claimId", 	prop.getProperty("ClaimNumber")) // Add claimId as a query parameter
				.get(endpoint);
	}


	@Then("Capture the Public id from the response")
	public void captureThePublicIdFromTheResponse() throws Exception {
		String PublicId = response.jsonPath().getString("result.publicID");
		Assert.assertNotNull("Public ID should not be null", PublicId);
		prop.setProperty("DD_publicID", PublicId, Filepath); // Store the fileId in config.properties
		Hooks.log("Extracted PublicId: " + PublicId);

	}

	@Then("Verify the uploaded document is displayed in the response")
	public void verifyTheUploadedDocumentIsDisplayedInTheResponse() {

		String expectedFileName = prop.getProperty("Filename");
		String expectedTimeStamp = prop.getProperty("timeStamp");

		// Parse JSON response
		JsonPath jsonPath = response.jsonPath();
		List<Map<String, String>> submittedDocuments = jsonPath.getList("submittedDocuments");

		// Verify if any fileName and timeStamp match the property file values
		boolean isMatchFound = false;
		for (Map<String, String> document : submittedDocuments) {
			String fileName = document.get("fileName");
			String timeStamp = document.get("timeStamp");


// Parse the original timestamp
			ZonedDateTime zonedDateTime = ZonedDateTime.parse(timeStamp);

// Format the timestamp to the desired format
			DateTimeFormatter formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm");
			String formattedTimeStamp = zonedDateTime.format(formatter);

			if (fileName.equals(expectedFileName) && formattedTimeStamp.equals(expectedTimeStamp)) {
				isMatchFound = true;
				Hooks.log("Match found: fileName = " + fileName + ", timeStamp = " + formattedTimeStamp);
				break;
			}
		}

		if (!isMatchFound) {
			Hooks.log("Error: No matching fileName and timeStamp found in the response.");
			Assert.fail("No matching fileName and timeStamp found in the response.");
		}
	}

	@When("a POST request is sent with XML body")
	public void aPOSTRequestIsSentWithXMLBody() {
		RestAssured.useRelaxedHTTPSValidation();
		String accountNumber = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("accountNumber");
		String firstname = "First" + generateRandomText(5);
		String lastname = "Last" + generateRandomText(5);
		String dobRaw = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("dateOfBirth");
		String dateOfBirth = dobRaw != null ? dobRaw.replace("/", "") : "";
		
		// Update the current row data with the new values
		Map<String, String> currentRowData = Hooks.currentRow.get();
		currentRowData.put("First Name", firstname);
		currentRowData.put("Last Name", lastname);
		
		String sheetName = Hooks.sheetName.get();
		JsonUtils.writeJsonData(sheetName, Hooks.data.get());
		Hooks.currentRow.set(currentRowData);

		requestBody = requestBody.replace("{{accountNumber}}", accountNumber != null ? accountNumber : "")
				.replace("{{firstname}}", firstname)
				.replace("{{lastname}}", lastname)
				.replace("{{dateOfBirth}}", dateOfBirth);
		Hooks.log("Sending XML POST request to: " + endpoint + " for claimant: " + firstname + " " + lastname);
		response = RestAssured // Removed 'Response' keyword here
				.given()
				.queryParam("authHandler", prop.getProperty("authToken"))
				.log().all() // Logs the request details
				.header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=ISO-8859-1")
				.header("Cookie", "$Version=0; JSESSIONID=0000" + prop.getProperty("authToken")+ ":-1; $Path=/")
				.header("User-Agent", "Jakarta Commons-HttpClient/3.1")
				.body(requestBody)
				.post(endpoint);

	}

	@Then("the response status code and confirmation number should be validated")
	public void theResponseStatusCodeAndConfirmationNumberShouldBeValidated() {
		int statusCode = response.getStatusCode();
		assertThat(statusCode, is(200));
		String confirmationNumber = response.xmlPath().getString("Response.ACK.result.submission.confirmationNumber");
		assertThat("Confirmation number should not be null", confirmationNumber, notNullValue());
		Hooks.log("Response status code validated: 200. Confirmation Number: " + confirmationNumber);
		Assert.assertTrue(!response.prettyPrint().contains("error"));

	}

        String documentTypes = row.get("SupportingDocumentTypes");
        if (files == null || files.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "The upload scenario requires SupportingFiles in the selected JSON row.");
        }
        if (documentTypes == null || documentTypes.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "The upload scenario requires actual SupportingDocumentTypes dropdown labels.");

                files, documentTypes, prop.getProperty("upload.folder"));
        row.put("VerifiedSupportingFiles", String.join("|", verified));

                + String.join(" | ", verified));

    @And("Verify the document are landed in GWCC with valid Author and Description")
    public void verifyTheDocumentIsDisplayedAreLandedInGWCCWith() throws InterruptedException {

        if (!ExternalValidation.shouldRun(
                "Verify the document are landed in GWCC with valid Author and Description")) {
            return;
        }
        String author = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("Author");
        String descriptionsJsonString; // This will hold the JSON array as a string

        String scenarioType = Hooks.getScenarioType();
        if ("WSIB".equals(scenarioType)) {
            descriptionsJsonString = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("Descriptions");
            Hooks.log("Using 'Descriptions' for WSIB scenario.");
        } else if ("NonWSIB".equals(scenarioType)) {
            descriptionsJsonString = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("nonDescriptions");
            Hooks.log("Using 'nonDescriptions' for NonWSIB scenario.");
        } else {
            Hooks.log("Unknown scenario type or neither WSIB nor NonWSIB tag found. Defaulting to 'Descriptions'.");
            descriptionsJsonString = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("Descriptions"); // Default to Descriptions
        }

        List<String> descriptions;
            descriptions = Arrays.stream(descriptionsJsonString.split("\\|"))
                    .map(String::trim)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
        Hooks.log("Verifying multiple documents in GWCC with Author: " + author + " and Descriptions: " + descriptions);
        
        // Use the plural version of the verification method for bulk validation
        Assert.assertTrue("Document validation failed in GWCC for descriptions: " + descriptionsJsonString,
                gwDocuments.verifyLandedDocuments(author, descriptions));
    }

        }

        String manipulatedLastName = "KKLast"+ generateRandomText(5);

    @Then("Setup Device Details on the Claim")
    public void setupDeviceDetailsOnTheClaim() {
        if (!ExternalValidation.shouldRun(
                "Setup Device Details on the Claim")) {
            return;
        }
        Map<String, String> rowData = Hooks.currentRow.get();
        List<Map<String, String>> devices = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            if (rowData.containsKey("DevicesData")) {
                devices = objectMapper.readValue(rowData.get("DevicesData"), new TypeReference<List<Map<String, String>>>(){});
            } else {
                if (rowData.containsKey("Device_Category")) {
                    Map<String, String> firstDevice = new java.util.HashMap<>(rowData);
                    devices.add(firstDevice);
                }
                int index = 1;
                while (rowData.containsKey("Device_Category_" + index)) {
                    Map<String, String> nextDevice = new java.util.HashMap<>();
                    String suffix = "_" + index;
                    nextDevice.put("Device_Category", rowData.get("Device_Category" + suffix));
                    nextDevice.put("Device_Type", rowData.get("Device_Type" + suffix));
                    nextDevice.put("Device_Status", rowData.get("Device_Status" + suffix));
                    nextDevice.put("Device_ServiceType", rowData.get("Device_ServiceType" + suffix));
                    nextDevice.put("Device_StartDate", rowData.get("Device_StartDate" + suffix));
                    nextDevice.put("Device_EndDate", rowData.get("Device_EndDate" + suffix));
                    nextDevice.put("Device_DecisionDate", rowData.get("Device_DecisionDate" + suffix));
                    nextDevice.put("PurposeReview", rowData.get("PurposeReview" + suffix));
                    nextDevice.put("Rationale", rowData.get("Rationale" + suffix));
                    devices.add(nextDevice);
                    index++;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Hooks.log("Error parsing Device Data: " + e.getMessage());
        }

        if (devices.isEmpty()) {
            Hooks.log("No device data found in JSON.");
            return;
        }

        int count = 1;
        for (Map<String, String> device : devices) {
            String DeviceCategory = device.get("Device_Category");
            String DeviceType = device.get("Device_Type");
            String Device_Status = device.get("Device_Status");
            String Device_ServiceType = device.get("Device_ServiceType");
            String Device_StartDate = device.get("Device_StartDate");
            String Device_EndDate = device.get("Device_EndDate");
            String Device_DecisionDate = device.get("Device_DecisionDate");
            String Device_Review = device.get("PurposeReview");
            String Rationale = device.get("Rationale");

            Hooks.log("Setup Device Details on the Claim (Record " + count + ")");
            Hooks.log("Device Data: Device Category="+ DeviceCategory +
                    ", Device Type=" + DeviceType +
                    ", Device Status=" + Device_Status +
                    ", Device Service Type=" + Device_ServiceType +
                    ", Device Start Date=" + Device_StartDate +
                    ", Device End Date=" + Device_EndDate +
                    ", Device Decision Date=" + Device_DecisionDate +
                    ", Review=" + Device_Review +
                    ", Rationale=" + Rationale);
            
            Assert.assertTrue(gwRecovery.setupDeviceData(DeviceCategory,DeviceType,Device_Status,Device_ServiceType,
                    Device_StartDate,Device_EndDate,Device_DecisionDate,Device_Review,Rationale));
            count++;
        }
    }

    @Then("Setup Clothing Allowance on the Claim")
    public void setupClothingAllowanceOnTheClaim() {

                "Setup Clothing Allowance on the Claim")) {
            return;
        }
        Map<String, String> rowData = Hooks.currentRow.get();
        List<Map<String, String>> dataList = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            if (rowData.containsKey("Clothing_Data")) {
                dataList = objectMapper.readValue(rowData.get("Clothing_Data"), new TypeReference<List<Map<String, String>>>(){});
            } else if (rowData.containsKey("ClothingAllowanceApproved")) {
                dataList.add(rowData);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) { Hooks.log("Error parsing Clothing Data: " + e.getMessage()); }

        int count = 1;
        for (Map<String, String> data : dataList) {
            String ClothingAllowanceApproved = data.get("ClothingAllowanceApproved");
            String ClothingAllowance_DecisionDate = data.get("ClothingAllowance_DecisionDate");

            Hooks.log("Setup Clothing Allowance on the Claim (Record " + count + ")");
            Assert.assertTrue(gwRecovery.setupClothingAllowanceData(ClothingAllowanceApproved,ClothingAllowance_DecisionDate));
            count++;
        }
    }

    @And("Search for the NIHL claimant in GWCC")
    public void searchForNIHLClaimantInGWCC() throws InterruptedException {
        if (!ExternalValidation.shouldRun("Search for the NIHL claimant in GWCC")) { return; }
        Map<String, String> row = nihlCurrentData();

        String lastName = nihlRequiredValue(row, "Last Name");
        String dob = getDateFormat(nihlRequiredValue(row, "dateOfBirth"),
                "d/MMMM/yyyy", "dd/MM/yyyy");
        Assert.assertTrue("NIHL claimant was not opened in GWCC within the configured search budget.",
                gwSearch.searchNIHLClaimant(firstName, lastName, dob,

                        nihlPositiveSetting("NIHLPollSeconds", 30)));
    }

    @And("Verify the NIHL submission documents landed in GWCC")
    public void verifyNIHLSubmissionDocumentsInGWCC(io.cucumber.datatable.DataTable table)
            throws InterruptedException {
        if (!ExternalValidation.shouldRun("Verify the NIHL submission documents landed in GWCC")) { return; }
        Map<String, String> row = nihlCurrentData();
        String reference = nihlRequiredValue(row, "NIHLGWCCReference");
        java.time.LocalDate submittedOn = java.time.LocalDate.parse(
                nihlRequiredValue(row, "NIHLSubmissionDate"));
        Map<String, String> options = table.asMap(String.class, String.class);
        if (!row.containsKey("HealthCareFiles") || !row.containsKey("EmploymentFiles")) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Upload inputs were not retained in this scenario's data. "
                    + "Apply the accompanying NIHL upload-step change.");
        }
        List<String> uploaded = new ArrayList<>();
        uploaded.addAll(nihlPipeValues(row.get("HealthCareFiles")));
        uploaded.addAll(nihlPipeValues(row.get("EmploymentFiles")));
        List<String> descriptions = nihlPipeValues(options.get("SupportingDescriptions"));
        List<String> authors = nihlPipeValues(options.get("SupportingAuthors"));
        if (descriptions.size() != uploaded.size()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Configured " + descriptions.size()
                    + " supporting GWCC descriptions for " + uploaded.size()
                    + " uploaded files. Supply one actual description per file, in health-care order "
                    + "followed by employment order. Filenames are not assumed to be descriptions.");
        }
        if (!uploaded.isEmpty()) {
            if (authors.size() != 1
                    && authors.size() != uploaded.size()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Supply one supporting-document author "
                                + "or one author per uploaded file.");
            }
        } else if (!authors.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "SupportingAuthors must be blank "
                            + "when no files were uploaded.");
        }
        List<GWDocumentsPage.NIHLDocumentExpectation> expected = new ArrayList<>();
        // Preserve the report's existing contains-matching, not its legacy retry/baseline logic.
        expected.add(new GWDocumentsPage.NIHLDocumentExpectation(
                nihlRequiredValue(row, "Author"), nihlRequiredValue(row, "Description"), false));
        for (int i = 0; i < descriptions.size(); i++) {
            expected.add(new GWDocumentsPage.NIHLDocumentExpectation(
                    authors.size() == 1 ? authors.get(0) : authors.get(i), descriptions.get(i), false));
        }
        Hooks.log("[NIHL GWCC] Verifying reference " + reference
                + "; expected report/supporting row occurrences=" + expected.size());
        Assert.assertTrue("NIHL GWCC document verification timed out for reference " + reference
                        + ". Expected: " + expected,
                gwDocuments.verifyNIHLUNCDDocuments(expected, submittedOn,
                        nihlPositiveSetting("NIHLDocumentTimeoutSeconds", 900),
                        nihlPositiveSetting("NIHLPollSeconds", 30),
                        nihlPositiveSetting("NIHLMaxDocumentPages", 200)));
    }

    private Map<String, String> nihlCurrentData() {
        Map<String, String> row = Hooks.currentRow.get();
        if (row == null) { throw new IllegalStateException("NIHL scenario data is not initialized."); }
        return row;
    }

    private String nihlRequiredValue(Map<String, String> values, String key) {
        String value = values.get(key);
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing NIHL test value: " + key);
        }
        return value.trim();
    }

    private List<String> nihlPipeValues(String value) {
        List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) { return result; }
        for (String token : value.split("\\|", -1)) {
            String item = token.trim();
            if (item.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty item in NIHL pipe-separated input: " + value);
            }
            if (item.startsWith("REPLACE_")) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Replace the NIHL GWCC mapping placeholder: " + item);
            }
            result.add(item);
        }
        return result;
    }

    private int nihlPositiveSetting(String key, int defaultValue) {
        String configured = prop.getProperty(key);
        if (configured == null || configured.trim().isEmpty()) { return defaultValue; }
        try {
            int value = Integer.parseInt(configured.trim());
            if (value <= 0) { throw new NumberFormatException("not positive"); }
            return value;
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(key + " must be a positive integer; found " + configured, e);
        }
    }



}

package definitions;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.logging.Level;

import org.openqa.selenium.*;
import com.aventstack.extentreports.ExtentTest;
import com.aventstack.extentreports.Status;
import com.aventstack.extentreports.MediaEntityBuilder;
import io.cucumber.java.*;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeOptions;
import io.github.bonigarcia.wdm.WebDriverManager;
import org.openqa.selenium.edge.EdgeDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.edge.EdgeOptions;
import org.openqa.selenium.logging.LogType;

public class Hooks {
    private static ThreadLocal<ConfigReader> configReader = new ThreadLocal<>();
    private static ThreadLocal<ConfigReader> commonPropReader = new ThreadLocal<>();
    public static ThreadLocal<List<Map<String, String>>> data = new ThreadLocal<>();
    public static ThreadLocal<Integer> currentIndex = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> 0);
    private static ThreadLocal<String> lastScenarioId = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> "");
    public static ThreadLocal<Map<String, String>> currentRow = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> null);
    private static ThreadLocal<WebDriver> driver = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> null);
    public static ThreadLocal<String> sheetName = new ThreadLocal<>();
    private static ThreadLocal<String> scenarioName = new ThreadLocal<>();
    public static ThreadLocal<ExtentTest> extentTest = new ThreadLocal<>();
    public static ThreadLocal<Scenario> scenario = new ThreadLocal<>();
    public static ThreadLocal<String> scenarioType = new ThreadLocal<>();
    private static ConcurrentHashMap<String, AtomicInteger> scenarioCounter = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    // Cucumber creates a Hooks instance per scenario. Capture state is thread-local.
    private String lastNetworkSummary = "";
    private boolean uiCheckWarningLogged;

    @Before(order = 0)
    public void setup(Scenario scenario) {
        Hooks.scenario.set(scenario);
        lastNetworkSummary = "";
        uiCheckWarningLogged = false;
        NetworkDiagnostics.stop();
        String featureName = scenario.getUri().getPath().split("/")
                [scenario.getUri().getPath().split("/").length - 1].replace(".feature", "");
        String env = System.getProperty("env");
        if (env == null) {
            env = "SIT2";
            System.setProperty("env", "SIT2");
        }
        String propertyFilePath = "src/test/resources/config/" + env + "/" + featureName + ".properties";
        configReader.set(new ConfigReader(propertyFilePath));
        commonPropReader.set(new ConfigReader("src/test/resources/config/Common.properties"));
        String extractedSheetName = scenario.getSourceTagNames().stream()
                .filter(tag -> tag.startsWith("@SheetName_"))
                .map(tag -> tag.replace("@SheetName_", ""))
                .findFirst().orElse(null);
        sheetName.set(extractedSheetName);
        if (scenario.getSourceTagNames().stream().anyMatch(tag -> tag.startsWith("@NonWSIB"))) {
            scenarioType.set("NonWSIB");
        } else if (scenario.getSourceTagNames().stream().anyMatch(tag -> tag.startsWith("@WSIBForm"))) {
            scenarioType.set("WSIB");
        } else {
            scenarioType.set("Unknown");
        }
    }

    public static String getScenarioName() { return scenarioName.get(); }

    @Before(order = 1)
    public void loadData(Scenario scenario) throws IOException {
        String sheetname = getSheetName(scenario);
        if (sheetname == null || sheetname.isEmpty()) {
            scenario.log("Sheet name (JSON filename) could not be determined for this scenario");
            return;
        }
        String currentScenarioId = scenario.getUri().toString() + "_" + scenario.getName();
        if (data.get() == null || !currentScenarioId.equals(lastScenarioId.get())) {
            data.set(JsonUtils.readJsonData(sheetname));
            AtomicInteger counter = scenarioCounter.computeIfAbsent(currentScenarioId, k -> new AtomicInteger(0));
            currentIndex.set(counter.getAndIncrement());
            lastScenarioId.set(currentScenarioId);
        }
    }

    @Before(order = 2)
    public void setScenarioData(Scenario scenario) {
        List<Map<String, String>> testData = data.get();
        if (testData != null && !testData.isEmpty()) {
            int index = currentIndex.get();
            if (index < testData.size()) {
                currentRow.set(testData.get(index));
                currentIndex.set(index + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    public static String getSheetName(Scenario scenario) {
        return scenario.getSourceTagNames().stream()
                .filter(tag -> tag.startsWith("@SheetName_"))
                .map(tag -> tag.replace("@SheetName_", ""))
                .findFirst().orElse(null);
    }
    public static ConfigReader getConfigReader() {
        if (configReader.get() == null) throw new IllegalStateException("ConfigReader is not initialized.");
        return configReader.get();
    }
    public static ConfigReader getCommonReader() { return commonPropReader.get(); }
    public static WebDriver getDriver() { return driver.get(); }
    public static String getScenarioType() { return scenarioType.get(); }
    public static void log(String message) {
        System.out.println("[" + Thread.currentThread().getName() + "] " + message);
        if (scenario.get() != null) scenario.get().log(message);
        if (extentTest.get() != null) extentTest.get().info(message);
    }

    @Before
    public void openBrowser(Scenario scenario) throws Exception {
        if (scenario.getSourceTagNames().contains("@API")) {
            scenario.log("Skipping browser setup for @API tests.");
            return;
        }
        WebDriver webDriver;
        String browser = configReader.get().getProperty("browser").trim().toLowerCase();
        String headlessSysProp = System.getProperty("headless");
        boolean isHeadless = false;
        if (headlessSysProp != null) {
            isHeadless = headlessSysProp.trim().equalsIgnoreCase("true");
        } else if (commonPropReader.get().getProperty("headless") != null) {
            isHeadless = commonPropReader.get().getProperty("headless").trim().equalsIgnoreCase("true");
        }
        if (System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase().contains("linux") && System.getenv("DISPLAY") == null) {
            if (!isHeadless) {
                log("Linux CI detected (no DISPLAY), forcing Headless Mode: true");
                isHeadless = true;
            }
        }
        log("Browser: " + browser + " | Headless Mode: " + isHeadless);
        switch (browser) {
            case "chrome":
                try {
                    WebDriverManager.chromedriver().setup();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log("WebDriverManager failed for Chrome. Checking for local driver.");
                    String localPath = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase().contains("win")
                            ? "src/test/resources/config/chromedriver.exe" : "src/test/resources/config/chromedriver";
                    if (new File(localPath).exists()) System.setProperty("webdriver.chrome.driver", localPath);
                    else throw e;
                }
                ChromeOptions chromeOptions = new ChromeOptions();
                chromeOptions.setAcceptInsecureCerts(true);
                chromeOptions.addArguments("--remote-allow-origins=*");
                chromeOptions.addArguments("--no-sandbox");
                chromeOptions.addArguments("--disable-dev-shm-usage");
                chromeOptions.addArguments("--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled");
                chromeOptions.addArguments("--start-maximized");
                chromeOptions.setExperimentalOption("useAutomationExtension", false);
                chromeOptions.setExperimentalOption("excludeSwitches", new String[]{"enable-automation"});
                chromeOptions.addArguments("user-agent=Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36");
                if (NetworkDiagnostics.enabled(commonPropReader.get())) {
                    LoggingPreferences logging = new LoggingPreferences();
                    logging.enable(LogType.PERFORMANCE, Level.ALL);
                    chromeOptions.setCapability("goog:loggingPrefs", logging);
                }
                if (isHeadless) {
                    chromeOptions.addArguments("--headless=new");
                    chromeOptions.addArguments("--window-size=1920,1080");
                    chromeOptions.addArguments("--disable-gpu");
                    chromeOptions.addArguments("--disable-extensions");
                    chromeOptions.addArguments("--disable-setuid-sandbox");
                    chromeOptions.addArguments("--disable-software-rasterizer");
                }
                webDriver = new ChromeDriver(chromeOptions);
                driver.set(webDriver); // Also permits cleanup if later setup fails.
                ((JavascriptExecutor) webDriver).executeScript(
                        "Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', {get: () => undefined})");
                break;
            case "edge":
                try {
                    WebDriverManager.edgedriver().setup();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log("WebDriverManager failed for Edge. Checking for local driver.");
                    String localPath = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase().contains("win")
                            ? "src/test/resources/config/msedgedriver.exe" : "src/test/resources/config/msedgedriver";
                    if (new File(localPath).exists()) System.setProperty("webdriver.edge.driver", localPath);
                    else throw e;
                }
                EdgeOptions edgeOptions = new EdgeOptions();
                edgeOptions.setAcceptInsecureCerts(true);
                edgeOptions.setExperimentalOption("useAutomationExtension", false);
                edgeOptions.addArguments("--remote-allow-origins=*");
                edgeOptions.addArguments("--no-sandbox");
                edgeOptions.addArguments("--disable-dev-shm-usage");
                edgeOptions.setExperimentalOption("excludeSwitches", new String[]{"enable-automation"});
                if (NetworkDiagnostics.enabled(commonPropReader.get())) {
                    LoggingPreferences logging = new LoggingPreferences();
                    logging.enable(LogType.PERFORMANCE, Level.ALL);
                    edgeOptions.setCapability("ms:loggingPrefs", logging);
                }
                if (isHeadless) {
                    edgeOptions.addArguments("--headless=new");
                    edgeOptions.addArguments("--window-size=1920,1080");
                    edgeOptions.addArguments("--disable-gpu");
                }
                webDriver = new EdgeDriver(edgeOptions);
                driver.set(webDriver);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported browser: " + browser);
        }
        webDriver.manage().timeouts().implicitlyWait(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        webDriver.manage().deleteAllCookies();
        if (!isHeadless) webDriver.manage().window().maximize();
        String baseUrl = configReader.get().getProperty("baseUrl");
        NetworkDiagnostics.start(webDriver, commonPropReader.get(), baseUrl);
        log("Navigating to URL: " + baseUrl);
        webDriver.get(baseUrl);
    }

    /** After-step hooks run in descending order: this follows the original screenshot hook. */
    @AfterStep(order = 0)
    public void checkApplicationAndNetworkErrors(Scenario scenario) {
        if (driver.get() == null || !NetworkDiagnostics.enabled(commonPropReader.get())) return;
        NetworkDiagnostics.collect();
        boolean genericError = genericErrorVisible();
        if (scenario.isFailed() || genericError) attachNetworkEvidence(scenario);
        if (genericError && !scenario.isFailed()) {
            captureApplicationErrorScreenshot(scenario);
            if ("true".equalsIgnoreCase(commonSetting("network.capture.failOnUiError", "true"))) {
                // Only visible UI errors deliberately fail a scenario; a nearby failed API
                // alone does not. Preserve any failure already raised by the test.
                throw new AssertionError("Application displayed the configured generic error message. "
                        + "See browser-api-diagnostics; captured requests are not proof of root cause.");
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean genericErrorVisible() {
        String selectors = commonSetting("network.capture.uiErrorSelector", "h1,h2,h3,[role='alert'],[role='dialog']");
        String text = commonSetting("network.capture.uiErrorText", "something went wrong");
        try {
            Object visible = ((JavascriptExecutor) driver.get()).executeScript(
                    "var wanted = arguments[1].toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim();"
                            + "return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(arguments[0])).some(function(el) {"
                            + "var style = window.getComputedStyle(el);"
                            + "if (!el.getClientRects().length || style.display === 'none' || "
                            + "style.visibility === 'hidden' || style.opacity === '0') return false;"
                            + "var text = (el.innerText || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim();"
                            + "return text.length < 2000 && text.indexOf(wanted) !== -1;"
                            + "});", selectors, text);
            return Boolean.TRUE.equals(visible);
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            if (!uiCheckWarningLogged) {
                log("[NETWORK] UI error check unavailable (" + e.getClass().getSimpleName()
                        + "). Existing test assertions remain authoritative.");
                uiCheckWarningLogged = true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void attachNetworkEvidence(Scenario scenario) {
        try {
            String summary = NetworkDiagnostics.summary();
            if (summary.equals(lastNetworkSummary)) return;
            scenario.attach(summary, "text/plain", "browser-api-diagnostics");
            ExtentTest test = extentTest.get();
            if (test != null) test.info("<details><summary>Browser API diagnostics</summary><pre>"
                    + escapeHtml(summary) + "</pre></details>");
            System.out.println("[NETWORK] Attached browser API diagnostics to scenario reports.");
            lastNetworkSummary = summary;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[NETWORK] Unable to attach diagnostics (" + e.getClass().getSimpleName() + ").");
        }
    }
    private void captureApplicationErrorScreenshot(Scenario scenario) {
        try {
            byte[] image = ((TakesScreenshot) driver.get()).getScreenshotAs(OutputType.BYTES);
            scenario.attach(image, "image/png", "application-error");
            ExtentTest test = extentTest.get();
            if (test != null) test.info("Application error screenshot",
                    MediaEntityBuilder.createScreenCaptureFromBase64String(
                            Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(image)).build());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[NETWORK] Application error screenshot unavailable ("
                    + e.getClass().getSimpleName() + ").");
        }
    }
    private static String commonSetting(String key, String fallback) {
        ConfigReader common = commonPropReader.get();
        String value = common == null ? null : common.getProperty(key);
        return value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() ? fallback : value.trim();
    }
    private static String escapeHtml(String text) {
        return text.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;")
                .replace("\"", "&quot;").replace("'", "&#39;");
    }

    @After
    public void closeDriver() {
        WebDriver webDriver = driver.get();
        try {
            if (webDriver != null && NetworkDiagnostics.enabled(commonPropReader.get())) {
                NetworkDiagnostics.collect();
                Scenario current = scenario.get();
                if (current != null && current.isFailed()) attachNetworkEvidence(current);
            }
        } finally {
            NetworkDiagnostics.stop();
            try {
                if (webDriver != null) webDriver.quit();
            } finally {
                driver.remove();
                configReader.remove();
                commonPropReader.remove();
                data.remove();
                currentIndex.remove();
                lastScenarioId.remove();
                currentRow.remove();
                sheetName.remove();
                scenarioType.remove();
                scenario.remove();
                extentTest.remove();
            }
        }
    }

    // Original screenshot/retry reporting retained.
    @AfterStep
    public void logStepResult(Scenario scenario) {
        ExtentTest test = extentTest.get();
        if (test == null) return;
        String screenshotsProp = commonPropReader.get() != null
                ? commonPropReader.get().getProperty("screenshots") : null;
        boolean isScreenshotEnabledEveryStep = screenshotsProp != null
                && screenshotsProp.trim().equalsIgnoreCase("true");
        if (scenario.isFailed() || isScreenshotEnabledEveryStep) {
            WebDriver webDriver = driver.get();
            if (webDriver != null) {
                try {
                    final byte[] screenshot = ((TakesScreenshot) webDriver).getScreenshotAs(OutputType.BYTES);
                    scenario.attach(screenshot, "image/png", "step_screenshot");
                    Status status = Status.PASS;
                    String message = "Step Screenshot";
                    if (scenario.isFailed()) {
                        ITestResult result = Reporter.getCurrentTestResult();
                        boolean willRetry = false;
                        if (result != null && result.getMethod().getRetryAnalyzer(result) instanceof RetryLogic) {
                            RetryLogic logic = (RetryLogic) result.getMethod().getRetryAnalyzer(result);
                            if (!logic.isLastAttempt()) willRetry = true;
                        }
                        if (willRetry) {
                            status = Status.WARNING;
                            message = "Step Failed (Intermediate Attempt)";
                        } else {
                            status = Status.FAIL;
                            message = "Step Failed (Final Attempt)";
                        }
                    }
                    String screenshotBase64 = "data:image/png;base64,"
                            + Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(screenshot);
                    test.log(status, message,
                            MediaEntityBuilder.createScreenCaptureFromBase64String(screenshotBase64).build());
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log("Error while taking screenshot: " + e.getMessage());
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package definitions;

import io.cucumber.java.en.Given;
import io.cucumber.java.en.Then;
import io.cucumber.java.en.When;
import org.junit.Assert;
import org.openqa.selenium.JavascriptExecutor;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.logging.LogEntries;
import org.openqa.selenium.logging.LogEntry;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.WebDriverWait;

import pages.OSPC.HomePage;
import pages.OSPC.LoginPage;
import pages.UNCD.GetStarted;
import utils.ConfigReader;

import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.time.Duration;

public class LoginDefinition {
	private WebDriver driver;
	private WebDriverWait wait;
	private LoginPage loginPage;
	private HomePage homePage;
	private GetStarted getStarted;
	ConfigReader prop= Hooks.getConfigReader();
	ConfigReader common = Hooks.getCommonReader();
	public LoginDefinition() throws Exception {
		driver = Hooks.getDriver();
		wait = new WebDriverWait(driver, Duration.ofSeconds(Long.parseLong(common.getProperty("timeout"))));
		loginPage = new LoginPage(driver, wait);
		getStarted = new GetStarted(driver, wait);
		homePage = new HomePage(driver, wait);
	}

	@Given("^User is on login page$")
	public void loginPage() {
		Hooks.log("Verifying User is on Login Page.");
		Assert.assertTrue(loginPage.verifyOnLoginPage());
	}

	@When("^User submit email and password$")
	public void submitEmailPassword() {
		Hooks.log("Submitting Email and Password.");
		loginPage.loginToSite(prop.getProperty("OSPC_username"), prop.getProperty("OSPC_Password"));
	}

	@Then("^User should be able to login successfully and new page open$")
	public void successLogin() {
		Hooks.log("Verifying successful login.");
		Assert.assertTrue(homePage.verifyOnHomePage());
	}

	@Then("User should be able to login successfully and retrieve the token")
	public void userShouldBeAbleToLoginSuccessfullyAndRetrieveTheToken() throws Exception {
		Hooks.log("Verifying login and retrieving OAuth token.");
		Assert.assertTrue(homePage.verifyOnHomePage());
		// Retrieve browser logs
		LogEntries logEntries = driver.manage().logs().get("browser");

		String token = null;

		// Iterate through the logs to find the token
		for (LogEntry entry : logEntries) {
			String message = entry.getMessage();

			// Check if the log entry contains the token

			if (message.contains("Oauth token for request:")) {
				token = message.split("Oauth token for request:")[1].replaceAll("\"", " " ).trim();
				break;
			}
		}
		if (token == null) {
			Hooks.log("Error: Bearer token not found in console logs.");
			throw new RuntimeException("Bearer token not found in console logs.");
		}
		Hooks.log("Bearer Token retrieved successfully.");
		// Path to the properties file
		String propertiesFilePath = "src/test/resources/config/"+System.getProperty("env")+ "/OSPC_API.properties";
		// Update the BearerToken value
		prop.setProperty("BearerToken", token, propertiesFilePath);
	}

	@Then("User should be able to login successfully and retrieve the token for UNCD")
	public void userShouldBeAbleToLoginSuccessfullyAndRetrieveTheTokenUNCD() throws Exception {
		Hooks.log("Verifying Get Started page and retrieving token from session storage.");
		Assert.assertTrue(getStarted.verifyOnGetStartedPage());

		// Use JavascriptExecutor to retrieve all keys from sessionStorage
		JavascriptExecutor jsExecutor = (JavascriptExecutor) driver;
		String[] keys = ((String) jsExecutor.executeScript("return Object.keys(sessionStorage).toString();")).split(",");

		String secret = null;

		// Iterate through all keys to find the desired value
		for (String key : keys) {
			String value = (String) jsExecutor.executeScript("return sessionStorage.getItem(arguments[0]);", key);

			if (value != null && !value.isEmpty()) {
				try {
					org.json.JSONObject jsonObject = new org.json.JSONObject(value);
					if ("AccessToken".equals(jsonObject.optString("credentialType"))) {
						secret = jsonObject.optString("secret");
						break;
					}
				} catch (org.json.JSONException e) {
					// Ignore non-JSON values
				}
			}
		}

		if (secret == null || secret.isEmpty()) {
			Hooks.log("Error: Secret with credentialType:IdToken not found in sessionStorage.");
			throw new RuntimeException("Secret with credentialType:IdToken not found in sessionStorage.");
		}

		Hooks.log("Retrieved Secret successfully.");
		// Path to the properties file
		String propertiesFilePath = "src/test/resources/config/"+System.getProperty("env")+"/UNCD_API.properties";
		// Update the BearerToken value
		prop.setProperty("BearerToken", secret, propertiesFilePath);
	}


	@Then("Regenerate the Token for Claim Submission")
	public void regenerateTheTokenForClaimSubmission() throws Exception {
		Hooks.log("Regenerating Token for Claim Submission.");
		loginPage();
		submitEmailPassword();
		userShouldBeAbleToLoginSuccessfullyAndRetrieveTheToken();


	}

	@Then("User should be able to login successfully to OSBC portal")
	public void userShouldBeAbleToLoginSuccessfullyToOSBCPortal() {
		Hooks.log("Verifying successful login to OSBC portal.");
		Assert.assertTrue(homePage.verifyOSBCUnifiedLandingPage());
	}
}

	public Clothingallowance(WebDriver driver, WebDriverWait wait) {
		super(driver, wait);
		PageFactory.initElements(driver, this);
	}

	public Boolean enterClothingAllowanceDetails(String telephone, String pdpNel, String receivedCa, String otherClaim, String isEmployed,
												 String usesDeviceAtWork, String employerPaysForUniform, String uniform,
												 String damage, String date, String hoursPerDay, String daysPerWeek,
												 String UpperBody, String LowerBody, String OtherDevice, String metalParts, String repairOrReplaced) throws InterruptedException {
		waitUntilElementVisible(telephoneNumber);
		Enter(telephoneNumber, telephone);
		if(pdpNel.equalsIgnoreCase("Yes")){
			Click(PDPNelYes);
		}else{
			Click(PDPNelNo);
		}
		if(receivedCa.equalsIgnoreCase("Yes")){
			Click(receivedCaYes);
			Enter(otherClaimNumber, otherClaim);
		}else{
			Click(receivedCaNo);
		}

		if(isEmployed.equalsIgnoreCase("Yes")){
			Click(isEmployedYes);
		}else{
			Click(isEmployedNo);
		}
		if(usesDeviceAtWork.equalsIgnoreCase("Yes")){
			Click(usesDeviceAtWorkYes);
		}else{
			Click(usesDeviceAtWorkNo);

		}
		if(employerPaysForUniform.equalsIgnoreCase("Yes")){
			Click(employerPaysForUniformYes);
		}else{
			Click(employerPaysForUniformNo);
		}
		if(uniform.equalsIgnoreCase("Over")){
			Click(uniformOverClothing);
		}else{
			Click(uniformInsteadClothing);
		}
		Enter(this.damage, damage);
		String[] dob = date.split("/");
		GWSelect(day, dob[0]);
		GWSelect(month, dob[1]);
		GWSelect(year, dob[2]);
		Enter(this.hoursPerDay, hoursPerDay);
		Enter(this.daysPerWeek, daysPerWeek);
		if (UpperBody.equalsIgnoreCase("Arm Brace")) {
			Click(armBrace);
		} else if (UpperBody.equalsIgnoreCase("Back Brace")) {
			Click(backBrace);
		} else if (UpperBody.equalsIgnoreCase("Back Support")) {
			Click(backSupport);
		} else if (UpperBody.equalsIgnoreCase("Cervical Brace")) {
			Click(cervicalBrace);
		}

		if(LowerBody.equalsIgnoreCase("Leg brace (permanent)")){
			Click(legBrace);
		}else if(LowerBody.equalsIgnoreCase("Leg Prothesis")){
			Click(legProsthesis);
		}else if(LowerBody.equalsIgnoreCase("Under arm/forearm supported crutches")){
			Click(crutches);
		} else if(LowerBody.equalsIgnoreCase("Wheelchair")) {
			Click(wheelChair);
		}

		if(!OtherDevice.isEmpty()){
			Enter(otherDevice, OtherDevice);
		}
		if(metalParts.equalsIgnoreCase("Yes")){
			Click(metalPartsYes);
			//Click(metalPartsYes);
		}else{
			Click(metalPartsNo);
		}

		if(repairOrReplaced.equalsIgnoreCase("Yes")){
			jsMoveClick(repairOrReplacedYes);
		}else{
			jsMoveClick(repairOrReplacedNo);
		}

		jsMoveClick(NextButton);
		return ReviewHeader.isDisplayed();

	}

	public boolean reviewAndSubmit(String email) {

		if(!email.isEmpty()){
			Click(isEmailNeeded);
			Enter(emailAddress, email);
		}
		Click(declaration);
		Click(SubmitButton);
		ConfirmationHeader.isDisplayed();
		return ConfirmationHeader.isDisplayed();

		Set<String> windowHandles = getDriver().getWindowHandles();
		List<String> tabs = new ArrayList<>(windowHandles);
		getDriver().close();
		getDriver().switchTo().window(tabs.get(0)); // Assuming the first tab is the main one
		Click(navigationSection);
		waitUntilElementVisible(directDepositButton);
		Click(directDepositButton);
		waitUntilElementVisible(NoDirectDepositMessage);

									 String whatSubstance, String DescribeWhere, String Whatareyouwearing) throws InterruptedException {

			Enter(this.exposureDate, exposureDate);

			DynamicTextClick(howContacted);
			Enter(affectedAreaDetails, DescribeWhere);
			Enter(protectiveEquipmentInfo, Whatareyouwearing);

		}

		PageFactory.initElements(driver, this);
	}


	public void enterHealthCareDetails(String healthCareReceived, String whereHealthCareReceived, String healthCareReceivedDate, String emplReportedDate,
									   String reporter, String provider, String providerOrg, String providerOrgAddress, String whendoyouexpect)  {

		if (healthCareReceived.equalsIgnoreCase("Yes")) {
			Click(healthCareYes);
			Click(fromWhere);
			DynamicTextClick(whereHealthCareReceived);
			Click(this.healthCareReceivedDate);
			Enter(this.healthCareReceivedDate, healthCareReceivedDate);
			Click(this.employerReportedDate);
			Enter(this.employerReportedDate, emplReportedDate);
			Click(addReporterButton);
			Enter(ReporterFirstName, reporter.split("\\|")[0]);
			Enter(ReporterLastName, reporter.split("\\|")[1]);
			Enter(ReporterPosition, reporter.split("\\|")[2]);
			jsMoveSendKeys(ReporterPhoneNumber, reporter.split("\\|")[3]);
			Click(saveButtonReporter);
			Sleep(3000);
			if(!provider.isEmpty()) {
				Click(addProviderContactButton);
				Enter(ProviderFirstName, provider.split("\\|")[0]);
				Enter(ProviderLastName, provider.split("\\|")[1]);
				jsMoveSendKeys(ProviderPhoneNumber, provider.split("\\|")[2]);
				Click(saveButtonProvider);
			}
			else if(!providerOrg.isEmpty()) {
				Click(addProviderOrgButton);
				Enter(ProviderOrgName, providerOrg.split("\\|")[0]);
				jsMoveSendKeys(ProviderOrgPhoneNumber, providerOrg.split("\\|")[1]);
				Enter(ProviderOrgAddressLine1, providerOrgAddress.split("\\|")[0]);
				Enter(ProviderOrgCity, providerOrgAddress.split("\\|")[1]);
				Click(ProviderOrgProvinceDropdown);
				ClickusingActions(providerOrgAddress.split("\\|")[2]);
				Enter(ProviderOrgPostalCode, providerOrgAddress.split("\\|")[3]); // This is a sendKeys, not a click
				Click(ProviderOrgCountryDropdown);
				ClickusingActions(providerOrgAddress.split("\\|")[4]);
				Click(saveButtonProviderOrg);
			}


		} else if (healthCareReceived.equalsIgnoreCase("No")) {
			Click(healthCareNo);

		} else {
			Click(healthCareUnsure);
			if(whendoyouexpect.isEmpty()) {
				Click(NoDatePlannedYetCheckbox);
			}else {
				Click(this.whendoyouexpect);
				Enter(this.whendoyouexpect, whendoyouexpect);
			}

		}
		Sleep(3000);
		Click(nextButton);
	}
}

	@FindBy(xpath = "//*[@id=\"radioTimeLost\"]/div[2]/label") private WebElement AddClaimtoProfileNo;
	@FindBy(xpath = "//*[@id=\"intakeBodySection\"]/div[2]/div[1]/span[2]/a/span") private WebElement submitReportButton;

	@FindBy(xpath = "//*[@id=\"returnToDashboardButton\"]/span") private WebElement returnToDashboardButton;
	@FindBy(xpath = "//*[@id=\"claimSummaryBodySection\"]") private WebElement ClaimSummaryPage;

	public DIeForm6_ReviewandSubmit(WebDriver driver, WebDriverWait wait) {
		super(driver, wait);
		PageFactory.initElements(driver, this);

	public boolean verifyReviewAndSubmitReport() {

		waitUntilElementVisible(this.DeclarationCheckbox);
		Click(this.DeclarationCheckbox);
		Click(nextButton);
		waitUntilElementVisible(this.AddClaimtoProfile);
		return AddClaimtoProfile.isDisplayed();
	}

	public boolean verifyReturnToDashBoard() {
			if(isDisplayed(ModalPopup)) {
				Click(DistributionPopUpNo);
			}
		if (isDisplayed(returnToDashboardButton)) {
			waitUntilElementVisible(this.returnToDashboardButton);
			Click(returnToDashboardButton);
			waitUntilElementVisible(this.ClaimSummaryPage);
			return this.ClaimSummaryPage.isDisplayed();
		} else {
			System.out.println("Return to Dashboard button is not displayed");
			return false;
		}
	}

	public boolean verifyReviewAndSubmitExposure() {
		waitUntilElementVisible(this.DeclarationCheckbox);
		Click(this.DeclarationCheckbox);
		Click(submitReportButton);
		waitUntilElementVisible(this.confirmationMessage);
		return confirmationMessage.isDisplayed();
	}

	public boolean selectAddClaimtoProfile(String addClaimtoProfile) throws InterruptedException {

		if (addClaimtoProfile.equalsIgnoreCase("Yes")) {
			Click(AddClaimtoProfile);
		} else {
			Click(AddClaimtoProfileNo);
		}
		Click(submitReportButton);
		Sleep(5000);
		waitUntilElementVisible(this.confirmationMessage);
		return confirmationMessage.isDisplayed();
	}

	private WebElement nextButton;

	private WebElement documentTypeWrapper;
	// The closed dropdown HTML does not include its options. Support normal ARIA
	// options and react-select's generated option IDs; require an exact visible label.
	@FindBy(css = "#ddlWhoCompleted-wrapper [role='option'], "
			+ "#ddlWhoCompleted-wrapper [id*='-option-'], "
			+ "[id^='react-select-'][id*='-option-']")
	private List<WebElement> documentTypeOptions;
	@FindBy(id = "chkTerm")
	private WebElement confirmationInput;
	@FindBy(css = "label[for='chkTerm']")
	private WebElement confirmationLabel;

	private WebElement submittedDocumentsHeading;

	private WebElement submittedDocumentsTable;

	private List<WebElement> submittedRows;

	private List<WebElement> pageSizeButtons;
	@FindBy(css = "#SubmittedDocumentsDataTable a.jut__Pagination__paginationMenuItem[data-code='All']")
	private List<WebElement> showAllOptions;

	private List<WebElement> resultCounters;
	@FindBy(css = "#SubmittedDocumentsDataTable .-loading.-active")
	private List<WebElement> activeTableLoaders;

	public DIeForm6_SupportingDocuments(WebDriver driver, WebDriverWait wait) {
		super(driver, wait);
		this.pageDriver = driver;
		this.pageWait = wait;
		PageFactory.initElements(driver, this);
	}

	/** Existing callers still skip optional documents; no JSON upload data is read. */
	public void enterSupportingDocuments() {
		Sleep(2000);
		Click(nextButton);
	}

	private boolean isDocumentTypeSelected(String label) {
		String expected = normalize(label);

		try {
			if (!documentTypeControl.isDisplayed()) {
				return false;
			}

			if (expected.equals(normalize(documentTypeControl.getText()))) {
				return true;
			}

			for (WebElement element : documentTypeControl.findElements(
					By.xpath(".//*[not(self::input)]"))) {

				if (element.isDisplayed()
						&& expected.equals(normalize(element.getText()))) {
					return true;
				}
			}

			return false;

		} catch (NoSuchElementException
		         | StaleElementReferenceException e) {
			return false;
		}
	}

	private String currentDocumentTypeText() {
		try {
			return documentTypeControl.getText().trim();

		} catch (NoSuchElementException
		         | StaleElementReferenceException e) {
			return "<control unavailable or re-rendering>";
		}
	}

	private boolean hasConfirmedEmptyHistory() {
		for (WebElement message : emptyHistoryMessages) {
			try {
				if (message.isDisplayed()
						&& "you have not submitted any documents yet"
						.equals(normalize(message.getText()))) {

					return true;
				}

			} catch (StaleElementReferenceException e) {
				// The table may be transitioning from empty to populated.
				return false;
			}
		}

		return false;
	}

	/** Strict no-document test: start a fresh report and assert the history is empty. */
	public void continueWithoutSupportingDocuments() {
		waitForSupportingScreen();
		long stageStarted = System.nanoTime();
		HistorySnapshot before = readCompleteHistory();

		if (!before.rows.isEmpty()) {
			throw new AssertionError("The no-document test found existing submitted documents "
					+ "on this report. Start a fresh Form 6 application.");
		}
		Hooks.log("[FORM 6 DOCUMENTS] No submitted documents listed; continuing without uploads.");
		continueToComments();
	}

	/** One file/type or pipe-separated files/types; one type may be reused for all files. */
	public List<String> enterSupportingDocuments(String filenames, String documentTypes,
	                                             String uploadFolder) {
		List<Path> files = resolveFiles(filenames, uploadFolder);
		List<String> types = parsePipe(documentTypes, "SupportingDocumentTypes");
		if (types.size() != 1 && types.size() != files.size()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Provide one SupportingDocumentTypes label for all files "
					+ "or one label per SupportingFiles entry.");
		}
		waitForSupportingScreen();
		List<String> verified = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int i = 0; i < files.size(); i++) {
			Path file = files.get(i);
			String filename = file.getFileName().toString();
			String type = types.size() == 1 ? types.get(0) : types.get(i);
			// Capture IDs BEFORE this file is selected/submitted. An older row with
			// the same filename cannot satisfy the current submission.
			HistorySnapshot before = readCompleteHistory();
			LocalDate selectedOn = LocalDate.now();
			assertNoVisibleErrors();
			Hooks.log("[FORM 6 DOCUMENTS] Uploading " + filename + "; document type=" + type);
			pageWait.until(ExpectedConditions.presenceOfElementLocated(By.id("fileupload")));
			fileInput.sendKeys(file.toString());
			new WebDriverWait(pageDriver, Duration.ofSeconds(setting(
					"eform6.supporting.upload.timeout.seconds", 120)))
					.until(driver -> {
						assertNoVisibleErrors();
						try {
							String selected = selectedFileText.getText().trim()
									.replaceFirst("(?i)^Uploaded file:\\s*", "");
							return filename.equals(selected)
									&& "100%".equals(uploadPercentage.getText().trim());
						} catch (NoSuchElementException | StaleElementReferenceException e) {
							return false;
						}
					});
			selectDocumentType(type);
			if (!confirmationInput.isSelected()) {
				Click(confirmationLabel);
			}
			pageWait.until(driver -> confirmationInput.isSelected());
			assertNoVisibleErrors();
			pageWait.until(ExpectedConditions.elementToBeClickable(submitDocumentButton));
			// Submit ONCE. History polling must not re-submit and create duplicates.
			Click(submitDocumentButton);
			waitForNewHistoryRow(filename, before.ids, selectedOn);
			verified.add(filename);
			Hooks.log("[FORM 6 DOCUMENTS] VERIFIED new submitted-history row for " + filename);
		}
		continueToComments();
		return verified;
	}

	public void enterAdditionalComments(String additionalComments) {
		waitUntilElementVisible(this.additionalCommentsInput);
		Enter(this.additionalCommentsInput, additionalComments);
		Click(nextButton);
	}

	private void waitForSupportingScreen() {
		pageWait.until(driver -> {
			try {
				return supportingHeading.isDisplayed()
						&& "Submit supporting documents".equals(supportingHeading.getText().trim());
			} catch (NoSuchElementException | StaleElementReferenceException e) {
				return false;
			}
		});
	}

	private void continueToComments() {
		Click(nextButton);
		waitUntilElementVisible(additionalCommentsInput);
	}

	private Integer displayedHistoryTotal() {
		for (WebElement counter : resultCounters) {
			if (!counter.isDisplayed()) {
				continue;
			}

			Matcher matcher = Pattern.compile("(\\d+)\\s*$").matcher(
					counter.getText()
							.replace(",", "")
							.replace('\u00a0', ' ')
							.trim());

			if (!matcher.find()) {
				throw new IllegalStateException(
						"Cannot read history result count: "
								+ counter.getText());
			}

			return Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));
		}

		return null;
	}

	private void selectDocumentType(String label) {
		if (label == null || label.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException(
					"A document-type label is required.");
		}

		// The application may retain the previous file's document type.
		if (isDocumentTypeSelected(label)) {
			Hooks.log("[FORM 6 DOCUMENTS] Document type already selected: "
					+ label);
			return;
		}

		Click(documentTypeWrapper);
		documentTypeInput.clear();
		documentTypeInput.sendKeys(label);

		WebElement option;

		try {
			option = pageWait.until(driver -> {
				try {
					WebElement match = null;

					for (WebElement candidate : documentTypeOptions) {
						if (candidate.isDisplayed()
								&& normalize(candidate.getText())
								.equals(normalize(label))) {

							if (match != null) {
								throw new IllegalStateException(
										"Multiple visible options match: " + label);
							}

							match = candidate;
						}
					}

					return match;

				} catch (NoSuchElementException
				         | StaleElementReferenceException e) {
					return null;
				}
			});

		} catch (TimeoutException e) {
			throw new TimeoutException(
					"Document-type OPTION was not found: '" + label
							+ "'. Check the configured label and open-menu selectors.",
					e);
		}

		option.click();

		try {
			pageWait.until(driver -> isDocumentTypeSelected(label));

		} catch (TimeoutException e) {
			throw new TimeoutException(
					"Clicked document-type option '" + label
							+ "', but could not verify its selected display."
							+ " Current control text: ["
							+ currentDocumentTypeText() + "]",
					e);
		}

		Hooks.log("[FORM 6 DOCUMENTS] Document type selected and verified: "
				+ label);
	}

	private long logUploadStage(
			String filename, String stage, long startedAt) {

		long now = System.nanoTime();

		Hooks.log(String.format(
				Locale.ROOT,
				"[FORM 6 TIMING] %s | %s | %.2f seconds",
				filename,
				stage,
				(now - startedAt) / 1_000_000_000.0));

		return now;
	}

	private void waitForNewHistoryRow(String filename, Set<String> baselineIds, LocalDate selectedOn) {
		final Set<String> baseline = new HashSet<>(baselineIds);
		try {
			new WebDriverWait(pageDriver, Duration.ofSeconds(setting(
					"eform6.supporting.history.timeout.seconds", 300)))
					.pollingEvery(Duration.ofMillis(500))
					.until(driver -> {
						assertNoVisibleErrors();
						try {
							ensureShowAll();
							HistorySnapshot snapshot = snapshotIfComplete();
							if (snapshot == null) { return false; }
							for (HistoryRow row : snapshot.rows) {
								if (filename.equals(row.filename) && !baseline.contains(row.id)
										&& !row.date.isBefore(selectedOn)
										&& !row.date.isAfter(LocalDate.now())) {
									return true;
								}
							}
							return false;
						} catch (NoSuchElementException | StaleElementReferenceException e) {
							return false;
						}
					});
		} catch (TimeoutException e) {
			throw new AssertionError("No NEW submitted-history row was verified for '" + filename
					+ "' within the configured timeout. The document was not automatically resubmitted.", e);
		}
	}

	private HistorySnapshot readCompleteHistory() {
		historyReadState = "Waiting for submitted-document history.";

		pageWait.until(
				ExpectedConditions.visibilityOf(submittedDocumentsHeading));

		pageWait.until(
				ExpectedConditions.visibilityOf(submittedDocumentsTable));

		ensureShowAll();

		WebDriverWait initialHistoryWait = new WebDriverWait(
				pageDriver, Duration.ofSeconds(30));

		return initialHistoryWait
				.withMessage(() ->
						"Form 6 initial document history is incomplete. "
								+ historyReadState
								+ ". Expected a complete result count or an explicit "
								+ "empty-history message.")
				.until(driver -> {
					try {
						return snapshotIfComplete();

					} catch (NoSuchElementException
					         | StaleElementReferenceException e) {

						historyReadState =
								"History is rendering: "
										+ e.getClass().getSimpleName();

						return null;
					}
				});
	}

	private void ensureShowAll() {
		Integer total = displayedHistoryTotal();
		if (total == null || total <= 10) {
			return;
		}
		for (WebElement button : pageSizeButtons) {
			if (!button.isDisplayed()) { continue; }
			String selection = normalize(button.getText());
			if ("all".equals(selection) || "show all".equals(selection)) { return; }
			Click(button);
			WebElement all = pageWait.until(driver -> {
				for (WebElement option : showAllOptions) {
					if (option.isDisplayed()) { return option; }
				}
				return null;
			});
			all.click();
			pageWait.until(driver -> {
				for (WebElement current : pageSizeButtons) {
					String text = normalize(current.getText());
					if (current.isDisplayed() && ("all".equals(text) || "show all".equals(text))) {
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			});
			return;
		}
	}

	private HistorySnapshot snapshotIfComplete() {
		for (WebElement loader : activeTableLoaders) {
			if (loader.isDisplayed()) { return null; }
		}
		HistorySnapshot snapshot = new HistorySnapshot();
		DateTimeFormatter format = new java.time.format.DateTimeFormatterBuilder()
				.parseCaseInsensitive().appendPattern("dd MMM uuuu").toFormatter(Locale.ENGLISH);
		for (WebElement group : submittedRows) {
			if (!group.isDisplayed()) { continue; }
			List<WebElement> cells = group.findElements(By.cssSelector(".rt-td"));
			if (cells.size() < 2 || cells.get(0).getText().trim().isEmpty()) { continue; }
			WebElement name = cells.get(0).findElement(By.cssSelector("span[id^='name_']"));
			String id = name.getAttribute("id");
			if (id == null || id.trim().isEmpty()) {
				throw new IllegalStateException("Submitted-document row has no record ID.");
			}
			String filename = name.getText().trim();
			LocalDate date = LocalDate.parse(cells.get(1).getText().trim(), format);
			if (!snapshot.ids.add(id)) {
				throw new IllegalStateException("Duplicate document-row ID in submitted history: " + id);
			}
			snapshot.rows.add(new HistoryRow(id, filename, date));
		}
		Integer total = null;
		for (WebElement counter : resultCounters) {
			if (counter.isDisplayed()) {
				Matcher match = Pattern.compile("(\\d+)\\s*$").matcher(
						counter.getText().replace(",", "").replace('\u00a0', ' ').trim());
				if (!match.find()) {
					throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot read submitted-document result count: " + counter.getText());
				}
				total = Integer.parseInt(match.group(1));
				break;
			}
		}
		// Without a total, do not call an empty/partial table a complete baseline.
		boolean confirmedEmpty = hasConfirmedEmptyHistory();
		historyReadState =
				"Result-counter total=" + total
						+ "; parsed document rows=" + snapshot.rows.size()
						+ "; explicit empty message=" + confirmedEmpty;
// Populated tableâ€”or an empty table that provides a zero counter.
// Require the parsed rows to agree with the displayed total.
		if (total != null) {
			return total.intValue() == snapshot.rows.size()
					? snapshot
					: null;
		}
// Confirmed initial empty state from the supplied HTML.
// No counter or pagination is rendered in this state.
		if (snapshot.rows.isEmpty() && confirmedEmpty) {
			return snapshot;
		}
// Neither a complete counted table nor a confirmed empty table.
		return null;
	}

	private void assertNoVisibleErrors() {
		for (WebElement alert : validationAlerts) {
			if (alert.isDisplayed() && !"true".equalsIgnoreCase(alert.getAttribute("aria-hidden"))) {
				String message = alert.getText().trim();
				if (!message.isEmpty()) {
					throw new AssertionError("Form 6 supporting-document error: " + message);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private List<Path> resolveFiles(String value, String folder) {
		List<String> names = parsePipe(value, "SupportingFiles");
		if (names.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("The upload test needs at least one SupportingFiles entry. "
					+ "Use the no-document step for the skip test.");
		}
		Path base = Paths.get(folder == null || folder.trim().isEmpty()
				? "src/test/resources/DocUploadFiles" : folder.trim()).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
		Set<String> allowed = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList("docx", "jpeg", "jpg", "tiff", "tif", "pdf", "png"));
		Set<String> basenames = new HashSet<>();
		List<Path> files = new ArrayList<>();
		for (String name : names) {
			Path file = base.resolve(name).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
			if (!Files.isRegularFile(file) || !Files.isReadable(file)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Upload file does not exist or is not readable: " + file);
			}
			String basename = file.getFileName().toString();
			int dot = basename.lastIndexOf('.');
			String extension = dot < 0 ? "" : basename.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
			if (!allowed.contains(extension)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported positive-test file type: " + basename);
			}
			if (!basenames.add(basename.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Use unique file basenames within one upload list: " + basename);
			}
			files.add(file);
		}
		return files;
	}

	private List<String> parsePipe(String value, String key) {
		List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
		if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) { return result; }
		for (String token : value.split("\\|", -1)) {
			String item = token.trim();
			if (item.isEmpty() || item.startsWith("REPLACE_")) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Provide actual, non-empty " + key + " values: " + value);
			}
			result.add(item);
		}
		return result;
	}

	private int setting(String name, int fallback) {
		String value = prop.getProperty(name);
		if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) { return fallback; }
		try {
			int parsed = Integer.parseInt(value.trim());
			if (parsed <= 0) { throw new NumberFormatException("not positive"); }
			return parsed;
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " must be a positive integer.", e);
		}
	}

	private String normalize(String value) {
		return value.replace('\u00a0', ' ').trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
	}

	private static final class HistorySnapshot {
		private final Set<String> ids = new LinkedHashSet<>();
		private final List<HistoryRow> rows = new ArrayList<>();
	}
	private static final class HistoryRow {
		private final String id;
		private final String filename;
		private final LocalDate date;
		private HistoryRow(String id, String filename, LocalDate date) {
			this.id = id;
			this.filename = filename;
			this.date = date;
		}
	}
}

package pages.DynamicIntakeEform7;

import definitions.Hooks;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;

import utils.BaseDriverClass;
import utils.ConfigReader;

public class DIeForm7 extends BaseDriverClass {
	ConfigReader prop= Hooks.getConfigReader();



	@FindBy(xpath = "//*[@id='myModal' and @class='modalSurveyLink']") private WebElement ModalPopup;
	@FindBy(xpath = "//*[@class='DistributionPopUpButton2']") private WebElement DistributionPopUpNo;
	@FindBy(xpath = "//*[contains(@aria-label,'Report an injury or illness Go')]") private WebElement GOButton;
	@FindBy(id = "businessServicesTitle") private WebElement businessServicesTitle;
	@FindBy(id = "reportsGoButton") private WebElement reportsGoButton;
	@FindBy(id = "reportInjuryOrIllness") private WebElement submitNewReportGoButton;
	@FindBy(id = "accountListSingleSelect-wrapper") private WebElement accountListSingleSelect;
	@FindBy(xpath = "//*[@id=\"submitnewreport\"]/span/span") private WebElement submitnewreport;
	@FindBy(id = "privacyPolicyH3") private WebElement privacyPolicyH3;
	@FindBy(xpath = "//*[@id=\"divConcentContainer\"]/div/div/div[1]/span") private WebElement AgreeCheckbox;
	@FindBy(xpath = "//*[contains(@class,'rightImgIcon')]") private WebElement NextButton;
	@FindBy(id = "injuryIllnessCard") private WebElement injuryIllnessCard;
	@FindBy(id = "exposureCard") private WebElement exposureCard;
	@FindBy(id = "fatalityCard") private WebElement fatalityCard;
	@FindBy(id = "physicalInjuryCard") private WebElement physicalInjuryCard;
	@FindBy(id = "illnessCard") private WebElement illnessCard;
	@FindBy(id = "mentalHealthCard") private WebElement mentalHealthCard;
	@FindBy(id = "nihlCard") private WebElement nihlCard;
	@FindBy(id = "seriousInjuryCard") private WebElement seriousInjuryCard;




	public DIeForm7(WebDriver driver, WebDriverWait wait) {
		super(driver, wait);
		PageFactory.initElements(driver, this);
	}

	public Boolean verifyBusinessHomepage() {

		waitUntilElementVisible(GOButton);
		return GOButton.isDisplayed();

	}


	public boolean clickOnGOButton() throws InterruptedException {
		if(isDisplayed(ModalPopup)) {
			DistributionPopUpNo.click();
		}
//		GOButton.click();
//		Sleep(5000);
		//waitUntilElementVisible(businessServicesTitle);
		Click(GOButton);
		Click(submitNewReportGoButton);
		waitUntilElementVisible(submitnewreport);
		return submitnewreport.isDisplayed();
	}

	public boolean selectAccountAndStartReport(String accountNumber) throws InterruptedException {
		Select(accountListSingleSelect,accountNumber);
		Click(submitnewreport);
		waitUntilElementVisible(privacyPolicyH3);
		Sleep(2000);
		Click(AgreeCheckbox);
		Click(NextButton);
		Sleep(2000);
		if(isDisplayed(ModalPopup)) {
			Click(DistributionPopUpNo);
		}
		waitUntilElementVisible(injuryIllnessCard);
		return injuryIllnessCard.isDisplayed();
	}

	public boolean selectReportType(String reporttype) {
//		if(isDisplayed(ModalPopup)) {
//			Click(DistributionPopUpNo);
//		}
		if(reporttype.equalsIgnoreCase("Injury or Illness")) {
			Click(injuryIllnessCard);
		}
		else if(reporttype.equalsIgnoreCase("Exposure")) {
			Click(exposureCard);
		}
		else if(reporttype.equalsIgnoreCase("Fatality")) {
			Click(fatalityCard);
		}
		Click(NextButton);
		return true;
	}

	public boolean selectInjuryCategory(String injurycategory) {
		if(injurycategory.equalsIgnoreCase("Physical Injury")) {
			Click(physicalInjuryCard);
		}
		else if(injurycategory.equalsIgnoreCase("Illness")) {
			Click(illnessCard);
		}
		else if(injurycategory.equalsIgnoreCase("Mental Health")) {
			Click(mentalHealthCard);
		}
		else if(injurycategory.equalsIgnoreCase("NIHL")) {
			Click(nihlCard);
		}
		else if(injurycategory.equalsIgnoreCase("Serious Injury")) {
			Click(seriousInjuryCard);
		}
		Click(NextButton);
		return true;
	}
}
