    public boolean searchClaimant(
            String firstname,
            String lastname,
            String dateofbirth) throws InterruptedException {

        // Validate before interacting with the application.
        if (firstname == null || firstname.isBlank()
                || lastname == null || lastname.isBlank()
                || dateofbirth == null || dateofbirth.isBlank()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "First name, last name, and date of birth are required."
            );
        }

        boolean extendedVerification = "Yes".equalsIgnoreCase(
                Hooks.getConfigReader().getProperty("DocuploadVerification")
        );

        int maxAttempts = extendedVerification ? 50 : 2;
        Duration resultTimeout = Duration.ofSeconds(5);
        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();

        dateofbirth  = convertDate(dateofbirth, "DD/MM/YYYY");

        WebDriverWait resultWait = new WebDriverWait(
                Hooks.getDriver(), resultTimeout
        );
        resultWait.pollingEvery(Duration.ofMillis(300));

        Hooks.log(
                "[GWCC SEARCH] Starting claimant search."
                        + " Maximum attempts: " + maxAttempts
                        + "; result wait per attempt: "
                        + resultTimeout.toSeconds() + " seconds."
        );

        Hooks.log("[GWCC SEARCH] Opening Search and entering criteria.");

        Click(SearchTab);
        Enter(SearchFirstName, firstname.trim());
        Enter(SearchLastName, lastname.trim());
        Enter(SearchDOB, dateofbirth.trim());

        for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {

            Hooks.log(
                    "[GWCC SEARCH] Attempt " + attempt + "/" + maxAttempts
                            + ": submitting search."
            );

            // Submit again on every attempt.
            // Submission errors propagate instead of being hidden as "not found".
            Click(SearchButton);

            try {
                String claimNumber = resultWait.until(driver -> {
                    try {
                        if (!SelectClaimfromSearch.isDisplayed()
                                || !SelectClaimfromSearch.isEnabled()) {
                            return null;
                        }

                        String number =
                                SelectClaimfromSearch.getText().trim();

                        if (number.isEmpty()) {
                            return null;
                        }

                        // Use a direct click here to avoid nesting the waits
                        // and retries inside your custom Click() helper.
                        SelectClaimfromSearch.click();

                        // Success is returned only after the click succeeds.
                        return number;

                    } catch (NoSuchElementException
                             | StaleElementReferenceException
                             | ElementNotInteractableException e) {

                        // The result may not exist yet, may be refreshing,
                        // or may be temporarily unavailable for clicking.
                        return null;
                    }
                });

                long elapsedSeconds = Duration.ofNanos(
                        System.nanoTime() - startedAt
                ).toSeconds();

                Hooks.log(
                        "[GWCC SEARCH] SUCCESS: clicked claim " + claimNumber
                                + " on attempt " + attempt + "/" + maxAttempts
                                + ". Total elapsed: " + elapsedSeconds + " seconds."
                );

                return true;

            } catch (TimeoutException e) {

                Hooks.log(
                        "[GWCC SEARCH] Attempt " + attempt + "/" + maxAttempts
                                + ": no usable claim result could be clicked within "
                                + resultTimeout.toSeconds() + " seconds."
                );

                if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
                    Hooks.log(
                            "[GWCC SEARCH] Retrying: submitting the search again."
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        long elapsedSeconds = Duration.ofNanos(
                System.nanoTime() - startedAt
        ).toSeconds();

        Hooks.log(
                "[GWCC SEARCH] FAILED: no claim result was successfully clicked"
                        + " after " + maxAttempts + " attempts."
                        + " Total elapsed: " + elapsedSeconds + " seconds."
        );

        return false;
    }

    public boolean searchDIClaim(String firstname, String lastname, String dateofbirth) throws InterruptedException {
        Hooks.log("Searching DI Claim: " + firstname + " " + lastname + ", DOB: " + dateofbirth);
        Click(SearchTab);
        Enter(SearchFirstName, firstname);
        Enter(SearchLastName, lastname);
        jsSendKeys(SearchDOB, dateofbirth);
        for (int loop = 0; loop < 50; loop++) {
            Click(SearchButton);
            Sleep(2000);
            if (isDisplayed(SelectClaimfromSearch)) {
                if (SelectClaimfromSearch.getText().charAt(0) == '3') {
                    Hooks.log("Claim found in GWCC: " + SelectClaimfromSearch.getText());
                    Map<String, String> currentRowData = Hooks.currentRow.get();
                    currentRowData.put("Claim Number", SelectClaimfromSearch.getText());
                    JsonUtils.writeJsonData(Hooks.sheetName.get(), Hooks.data.get());
                    Hooks.currentRow.set(currentRowData);
                    Click(SelectClaimfromSearch);
                    break;
                } else {
                    Hooks.log("Waiting for Auto Registration to Complete... current value: " + SelectClaimfromSearch.getText());
                }
            } else {
                Hooks.log("Search Results not available Yet, trying again... Attempt: " + loop);
                Sleep(5000);
                Click(SearchTab);
            }
        }
        waitUntilElementVisible(OriginatingChannel);
        return OriginatingChannel.isDisplayed();
    }

    public boolean searchNIHLClaimant(String firstName, String lastName, String dob,
                                      int timeoutSeconds, int pollSeconds)
            throws InterruptedException {
        if (firstName == null || firstName.trim().isEmpty()
                || lastName == null || lastName.trim().isEmpty()
                || dob == null || dob.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("NIHL claimant name and DOB are required.");
        }
        if (timeoutSeconds <= 0 || pollSeconds <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("NIHL timeout and poll seconds must be positive.");
        }
        if (Hooks.currentRow.get() != null) {
            Hooks.currentRow.get().remove("NIHLGWCCReference");
        }
        final String expectedName = nihlSearchText(firstName + " " + lastName);
        final java.time.LocalDate expectedDob = java.time.LocalDate.parse(dob.trim(),
                java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd/MM/uuuu"));
        long started = System.nanoTime();
        long budget = Duration.ofSeconds(timeoutSeconds).toNanos();
        int attempt = 0;
        while (System.nanoTime() - started < budget) {
            attempt++;
            Hooks.log("[NIHL GWCC SEARCH] Attempt " + attempt + "; elapsed="
                    + Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).getSeconds()
                    + "s; budget=" + timeoutSeconds + "s.");
            Click(SearchTab);
            ClaimSearchField.clear();
            Enter(SearchFirstName, firstName.trim());
            Enter(SearchLastName, lastName.trim());
            jsSendKeys(SearchDOB, dob.trim());
            Click(SearchButton);
            long remaining = budget - (System.nanoTime() - started);
            if (remaining <= 0) {
                break;
            }
            WebDriverWait resultWait = new WebDriverWait(Hooks.getDriver(),
                    Duration.ofNanos(Math.min(remaining, Duration.ofSeconds(5).toNanos())));
            resultWait.pollingEvery(Duration.ofMillis(300));
            WebElement selected;
            try {
                selected = resultWait.until(driver -> {
                    try {
                        List<WebElement> matches = new ArrayList<>();
                        for (WebElement link : NIHLClaimResultLinks) {
                            if (!link.isDisplayed() || !link.isEnabled()) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            WebElement row = link.findElement(By.xpath("ancestor::tr[1]"));
                            String actualName = row.findElement(
                                    By.cssSelector("span[id$=':Claimant']")).getText();
                            String actualDobText = row.findElement(
                                    By.cssSelector("span[id$=':WorkerDateOfBirth']")).getText().trim();
                            java.time.LocalDate actualDob = java.time.LocalDate.parse(actualDobText,
                                    new java.time.format.DateTimeFormatterBuilder()
                                            .parseCaseInsensitive().appendPattern("dd/MMM/uuuu")
                                            .toFormatter(Locale.ENGLISH));
                            if (expectedName.equals(nihlSearchText(actualName))
                                    && expectedDob.equals(actualDob)
                                    && !link.getText().trim().isEmpty()) {
                                matches.add(link);
                            }
                        }
                        if (matches.size() > 1) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException("Multiple GWCC records match this NIHL claimant. "
                                    + "Use a submission/reference identifier; refusing to select the first record.");
                        }
                        return matches.isEmpty() ? null : matches.get(0);
                    } catch (StaleElementReferenceException e) {
                        return null;
                    } catch (NoSuchElementException e) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "NIHL search results do not match the supplied classic table layout.", e);
                    }
                });
            } catch (TimeoutException e) {
                Hooks.log("[NIHL GWCC SEARCH] Matching claimant is not visible yet.");
                nihlSearchPause(started, budget, pollSeconds);
                continue;
            }
            String reference;
            try {
                reference = selected.getText().trim();
                selected.click();
            } catch (StaleElementReferenceException | ElementNotInteractableException e) {
                Hooks.log("[NIHL GWCC SEARCH] Result changed before the click; retrying search.");
                nihlSearchPause(started, budget, pollSeconds);
                continue;
            }
            remaining = budget - (System.nanoTime() - started);
            if (remaining <= 0) {
                return false;
            }
            try {
                new WebDriverWait(Hooks.getDriver(), Duration.ofNanos(
                        Math.min(remaining, Duration.ofSeconds(15).toNanos())))
                        .until(org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.ExpectedConditions
                                .visibilityOf(NIHLUnnumberedDocumentsLink));
            } catch (TimeoutException e) {
                Hooks.log("[NIHL GWCC SEARCH] Clicked reference " + reference
                        + ", but the UNCD Documents link did not become visible. "
                        + "Another screen may have opened; no landing success is reported.");
                return false;
            }
            if (Hooks.currentRow.get() != null) {
                Hooks.currentRow.get().put("NIHLGWCCReference", reference);
            }
            Hooks.log("[NIHL GWCC SEARCH] SUCCESS: matched identity and opened UNCD reference "
                    + reference + ". Elapsed="
                    + Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).getSeconds() + "s.");
            return true;
        }
        Hooks.log("[NIHL GWCC SEARCH] TIMEOUT: matching NIHL claimant was not opened.");
        return false;
    }

    private String nihlSearchText(String text) {
        return text.replace('\u00a0', ' ').trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private void nihlSearchPause(long started, long budget, int pollSeconds)
            throws InterruptedException {
        long remaining = budget - (System.nanoTime() - started);
        if (remaining > 0) {
            long delay = Math.min(Duration.ofSeconds(pollSeconds).toMillis(),
                    Duration.ofNanos(remaining).toMillis());
            Sleep((int) Math.max(1L, Math.min(delay, Integer.MAX_VALUE)));
        }
    }

    }

--------------------------------------------------
package pages.NIHL;

import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebElement;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.FindBy;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.PageFactory;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.WebDriverWait;
import utils.BaseDriverClass;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

public class SupportingDocuments extends BaseDriverClass {

	@FindBy(xpath = "//app-supporting-documents//button[@aria-label='Next']")
	private WebElement NextButton;

	@FindBy(xpath = "//app-supporting-documents//a[@aria-label='Attach audiogram, if available']")
	private WebElement AttachedAudiogramLink;

	@FindBy(xpath = "//app-supporting-documents//input[@type='file' and @title='uploadAudiogram']")
	private WebElement AttachedAudiogramFile;

	@FindBy(xpath = "//app-supporting-documents//input[@type='file' and @title='uploadProofOfEmployment']")
	private List<WebElement> AttachedEmploymentFiles;

	@FindBy(xpath = "//app-supporting-documents//app-field-error-display")
	private List<WebElement> UploadErrors;

	@FindBy(xpath = "//app-review//h2[@aria-label='Review']")
	private WebElement ReviewHeading;

	public SupportingDocuments(WebDriver driver, WebDriverWait wait) {
		super(driver, wait);
		PageFactory.initElements(driver, this);
	}

	// Existing callers can continue to skip both optional upload sections.
	public void EnterSupportingDocuments() throws InterruptedException {
		EnterSupportingDocuments("", "", null);
	}

	public void EnterSupportingDocuments(String healthCareFiles,
	                                     String employmentFiles,
	                                     String uploadFolder)
			throws InterruptedException {

		waitUntilElementVisible(AttachedAudiogramLink);
		Sleep(5000);

		// Validate all configured paths before starting any uploads.
		List<Path> healthFiles = getUploadFiles(healthCareFiles, uploadFolder);
		List<Path> employmentDocuments = getUploadFiles(employmentFiles, uploadFolder);

		if (healthFiles.size() > 10) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("You can upload up to 10 audiograms.");
		}

		// Employment files map to employer upload controls in page order.
		// Capture runtime IDs because controls may disappear after uploading.
		List<String> employerIds = new ArrayList<>();
		Set<String> uniqueIds = new HashSet<>();

		if (employmentDocuments.size() > AttachedEmploymentFiles.size()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException(
					"Configured " + employmentDocuments.size()
							+ " employment files, but the page contains only "
							+ AttachedEmploymentFiles.size()
							+ " employer upload controls. Only one file per employer is allowed.");
		}

		for (int i = 0; i < employmentDocuments.size(); i++) {
			String id = AttachedEmploymentFiles.get(i).getAttribute("id");
			if (id == null || id.trim().isEmpty() || !uniqueIds.add(id)) {
				throw new IllegalStateException(
						"Employment upload controls must have unique IDs.");
			}
			employerIds.add(id);
		}

		verifyNoUploadErrors();

		// No multiple attribute: send one audiogram per selection.
		for (Path file : healthFiles) {
			AttachedAudiogramFile.sendKeys(file.toString());
			Sleep(5000);
			verifyNoUploadErrors();
		}

		// One employment document per employer.
		for (int i = 0; i < employmentDocuments.size(); i++) {
			getEmploymentFileInput(employerIds.get(i))
					.sendKeys(employmentDocuments.get(i).toString());
			Sleep(5000);
			verifyNoUploadErrors();
		}

		verifyNoUploadErrors();
		Click(NextButton);
		waitUntilElementVisible(ReviewHeading);
		Sleep(5000);
	}

	private List<Path> getUploadFiles(String configuredFiles, String uploadFolder) {
		List<Path> files = new ArrayList<>();

		// Missing or blank fields preserve the existing skip behaviour.
		if (configuredFiles == null || configuredFiles.trim().isEmpty()) {
			return files;
		}

		String folder = uploadFolder == null || uploadFolder.trim().isEmpty()
				? "src/test/resources/DocUploadFiles"
				: uploadFolder.trim();

		Path baseFolder = Paths.get(folder).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
		Set<String> fileNames = new HashSet<>();

		for (String value : configuredFiles.split("\\|", -1)) {
			String name = value.trim();
			if (name.isEmpty()) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Empty filename in upload data: " + configuredFiles);
			}

			// Absolute paths also work; relative paths use upload.folder.
			Path file = baseFolder.resolve(name).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
			if (!Files.isRegularFile(file) || !Files.isReadable(file)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Upload file does not exist or is not readable: " + file);
			}
			if (!fileNames.add(file.getFileName().toString())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Duplicate filename in the same section: " + file.getFileName());
			}
			files.add(file);
		}
		return files;
	}

	private WebElement getEmploymentFileInput(String employerId) {
		// Re-read the @FindBy list instead of hard-coding an employer ID.
		for (WebElement input : AttachedEmploymentFiles) {
			if (employerId.equals(input.getAttribute("id"))) {
				return input;
			}
		}
		throw new IllegalStateException(
				"Employment upload control not found for employer ID: " + employerId);
	}

	private void verifyNoUploadErrors() {
		for (WebElement error : UploadErrors) {
			// Inactive components may have aria-labels but no rendered text.
			String message = error.getText().trim();
			if (error.isDisplayed() && !message.isEmpty()) {
				throw new AssertionError("Supporting document upload error: " + message);
			}
		}
	}
}

	public List<String> uploadDocuments(String filenamesString) throws IOException {
		List<String> originalFilenames = Arrays.stream(filenamesString.split(","))
				.map(String::trim)
				.collect(Collectors.toList());

		List<String> timestampedAbsolutePaths = new ArrayList<>();
		List<String> timestampedFilenames = new ArrayList<>();

		// Generate a unique timestamp for the batch
		String timestamp = LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd_HHmmssSSS"));

		for (int i = 0; i < originalFilenames.size(); i++) {
			String originalFilename = originalFilenames.get(i);
			Path originalFilePath = Paths.get("src/test/resources/DocUploadFiles", originalFilename);

			// Extract filename without extension and its extension
			String fileNameWithoutExtension = originalFilename.substring(0, originalFilename.lastIndexOf('.'));
			String fileExtension = originalFilename.substring(originalFilename.lastIndexOf('.'));

			// Create new filename with timestamp and index to ensure uniqueness within the batch
			String newFilename = fileNameWithoutExtension + "_" + timestamp + "_" + i + fileExtension;
			Path newFilePath = Paths.get("src/test/resources/DocUploadFiles", newFilename);

			// Copy the original file to the new timestamped file path, overwriting if exists
			Files.copy(originalFilePath, newFilePath, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
			System.out.println("Copied original file '" + originalFilename + "' to '" + newFilename + "'");

			timestampedAbsolutePaths.add(newFilePath.toAbsolutePath().toString());
			timestampedFilenames.add(newFilename);
		}

		WebElement input = getDriver().findElement(By.cssSelector("input[type='file']"));
		((JavascriptExecutor) getDriver()).executeScript("arguments[0].style.display = 'block';", input);

		// Join the timestamped absolute paths with newline characters for multiple file upload
		String filePaths = String.join("\n", timestampedAbsolutePaths);
		input.sendKeys(filePaths);

		waitUntilElementVisible(OSPCWsibFormYes);
		// Return the list of timestamped filenames for further use (e.g., updating GWCC.json)
		return timestampedFilenames;
	}

	public Boolean selectWSIBForm(String wsibFormsString) {
		List<String> wsibFormSelections = Arrays.stream(wsibFormsString.split("\\|"))
				.map(String::trim)
				.collect(Collectors.toList());

		// Find all the file item containers.
		// This assumes the order of these containers in the DOM matches the order of files uploaded.
		List<WebElement> fileItemContainers = wait.until(ExpectedConditions.presenceOfAllElementsLocatedBy(By.cssSelector(".fileItemContainer")));

		if (fileItemContainers.size() != wsibFormSelections.size()) {
			throw new AssertionError("Mismatch between number of uploaded files and WSIB form selections provided in test data.");
		}

		for (int i = 0; i < fileItemContainers.size(); i++) {
			String currentWsibFormSelection = wsibFormSelections.get(i);
			WebElement currentFileContainer = fileItemContainers.get(i);

			// Construct the ID for the radio button group based on its index
			String radioGroupId = "docSource" + i;

			// Locate the "Yes" and "No" radio buttons within the current file's container
			WebElement yesRadioButton = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.id(radioGroupId + "_yes"));
			WebElement noRadioButton = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.id(radioGroupId + "_no"));

			// Determine whether to select "Yes" or "No"
			// We consider it a WSIB form if the selection string is not empty, "No", or "N/A"
			if (!currentWsibFormSelection.isEmpty() &&
					!currentWsibFormSelection.equalsIgnoreCase("No") &&
					!currentWsibFormSelection.equalsIgnoreCase("N/A")) {

				// Select "Yes"
				if (!yesRadioButton.isSelected()) {
					Click(yesRadioButton);
					System.out.println("Selected 'Yes' for file at index " + i + " (WSIB Form: " + currentWsibFormSelection + ")");
				}

				// IMPORTANT: If selecting "Yes" makes a *dropdown* appear to select the specific WSIB form type,
				// you would add the logic here to interact with that dropdown.
				// Example (uncomment and adapt if needed):

                WebElement wsibFormTypeDropdown = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.xpath(".//*[@id='wsibformselection-wrapper']"));
                Select(wsibFormTypeDropdown, currentWsibFormSelection);
                System.out.println("Selected WSIB form type: " + currentWsibFormSelection);


			} else {
				// Select "No"
				if (!noRadioButton.isSelected()) {
					Click(noRadioButton);
					System.out.println("Selected 'No' for file at index " + i);
				}
			}
		}
      return true;
    }

	/**
	 * Validates document history for single and multiple file uploads.
	 * Uses pipe delimiter ('|') for descriptions and categories to safely allow
	 * commas inside descriptions (e.g., "Dental report, treatment plan | Doctor note").
	 * Captures initial baseline counts across pagination before polling.
	 *
	 * @param filenamesString     Comma-separated filenames for cleanup (e.g., "report.pdf, note.png")
	 * @param documentCategories  Pipe-separated (or comma-separated) categories matching the files
	 * @param documentDescription Pipe-separated descriptions ('|') matching the files
	 */
	public Boolean DocumentHistory(String filenamesString, String documentCategories, String documentDescription) {
		// 1. Navigate to page
		Click(DocumentHistoryLink);
		waitUntilElementVisible(submittedDocumentsHeading);
		// 2. Parse expected files using pipe delimiter ('|')
		List<String> expectedDescriptions = (documentDescription != null && !documentDescription.trim().isEmpty())
				? Arrays.stream(documentDescription.split("\\|"))
				.map(String::trim)
				.filter(s -> !s.isEmpty())
				.toList()
				: Collections.emptyList();
		// Parse categories using '|' if present, otherwise fallback to ','
		List<String> categoriesList = Collections.emptyList();
		if (documentCategories != null && !documentCategories.trim().isEmpty()) {
			String catDelimiter = documentCategories.contains("|") ? "\\|" : ",";
			categoriesList = Arrays.stream(documentCategories.split(catDelimiter))
					.map(String::trim)
					.filter(s -> !s.isEmpty())
					.toList();
		}
		// Map each submitted document to a DocumentKey and count occurrences in this run
		Map<DocumentKey, Integer> newlySubmittedCounts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
		for (int i = 0; i < expectedDescriptions.size(); i++) {
			String desc = expectedDescriptions.get(i);
			String cat = "";
			if (!categoriesList.isEmpty()) {
				cat = (i < categoriesList.size()) ? categoriesList.get(i) : categoriesList.get(0);
			}
			DocumentKey key = new DocumentKey(desc, cat);
			newlySubmittedCounts.put(key, newlySubmittedCounts.getOrDefault(key, 0) + 1);
		}
		// Determine UI filter inputs (populate only if uniform across all submitted items)
		boolean isSingleCategory = !categoriesList.isEmpty() && new HashSet<>(categoriesList).size() == 1;
		String filterCategory = isSingleCategory ? categoriesList.get(0) : "";
		boolean isSingleDescription = (new HashSet<>(expectedDescriptions).size() == 1);
		String filterDescription = isSingleDescription ? expectedDescriptions.get(0) : "";
		String todayFilterDate = getCurrentDate("yyyy-MM-dd"); // For input filters
		String todayDisplayDate = getCurrentDate("dd MMM yyyy"); // E.g., "06 Oct 2026"
		// 3. Apply initial filter to establish baseline count
		applySearchFilters(filterCategory, filterDescription, todayFilterDate);
		// 4. Capture INITIAL baseline counts across all pages
		System.out.println("Reading baseline document counts across all pages...");
		Map<DocumentKey, Integer> initialCounts = getMatchingDocumentCountsAcrossPages(newlySubmittedCounts.keySet(), todayDisplayDate);
		// Target count needed to pass = initial baseline count + newly submitted count
		Map<DocumentKey, Integer> targetCounts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
		for (Map.Entry<DocumentKey, Integer> entry : newlySubmittedCounts.entrySet()) {
			DocumentKey key = entry.getKey();
			int initial = initialCounts.getOrDefault(key, 0);
			int needed = initial + entry.getValue();
			targetCounts.put(key, needed);
			System.out.println(String.format("Baseline for %s -> Existing count: %d, Newly submitted: %d, Target needed: %d",
					key, initial, entry.getValue(), needed));
		}
		// 5. Polling setup: up to 12 minutes (24 attempts x 30s)
		int maxAttempts = 24;
		int pollIntervalMillis = 30000;
		for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
			System.out.println("Attempt " + attempt + " of " + maxAttempts + " checking for new documents...");
			try {
				// Read current counts across all pages
				Map<DocumentKey, Integer> currentCounts = getMatchingDocumentCountsAcrossPages(newlySubmittedCounts.keySet(), todayDisplayDate);
				// Verify if all document requirements have reached their target count
				boolean allMet = true;
				for (Map.Entry<DocumentKey, Integer> entry : targetCounts.entrySet()) {
					DocumentKey key = entry.getKey();
					int required = entry.getValue();
					int current = currentCounts.getOrDefault(key, 0);
					if (current < required) {
						System.out.println(String.format("Waiting on %s: current count = %d, required = %d", key, current, required));
						allMet = false;
					}
				}
				if (allMet) {
					System.out.println("SUCCESS: All new document(s) have appeared in the table.");
					//cleanupUploadedFiles(filenamesString);
					return true;
				}
			} catch (Exception e) {
				System.err.println("Error reading document table on attempt " + attempt + ": " + e.getMessage());
			}
			// Wait before refreshing and checking again
			if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
				Sleep(pollIntervalMillis);
				getDriver().navigate().refresh();
				waitUntilElementVisible(submittedDocumentsHeading);
				applySearchFilters(filterCategory, filterDescription, todayFilterDate);
			}
		}
		System.err.println("FAILED: Timeout waiting for new document(s) to appear.");
		//cleanupUploadedFiles(filenamesString);
		return false;
	}
	/**
	 * Iterates through all pages in the table, accumulates matching counts for today's date,
	 * and resets back to Page 1 before returning.
	 */
	private Map<DocumentKey, Integer> getMatchingDocumentCountsAcrossPages(Set<DocumentKey> keysToWatch, String todayDisplayDate) {
		Map<DocumentKey, Integer> totalCounts = new HashMap<>();
		for (DocumentKey key : keysToWatch) {
			totalCounts.put(key, 0);
		}
		int currentPage = 1;
		int maxPagesToScan = 20; // Guard against infinite pagination loops
		while (currentPage <= maxPagesToScan) {
			// 1. Scan rows on current page
			countRowsOnCurrentPage(keysToWatch, todayDisplayDate, totalCounts);
			// 2. Check if a next page exists and is clickable
			if (hasNextPage()) {
				goToNextPage();
				currentPage++;
				Sleep(1000); // Allow table body to refresh
			} else {
				break;
			}
		}
		// 3. Reset back to page 1 if we traversed past it
		if (currentPage > 1) {
			resetToFirstPage();
		}
		return totalCounts;
	}
	/**
	 * Helper to scan and accumulate counts on the active table page.
	 * Uses exact case-insensitive matching for full description and category.
	 */
	private void countRowsOnCurrentPage(Set<DocumentKey> keysToWatch, String todayDisplayDate, Map<DocumentKey, Integer> counts) {
		List<WebElement> rows = getDriver().findElements(By.cssSelector("div[id^='SubmittedDocumentsDataTable'] .rt-tr-group"));
		for (WebElement row : rows) {
			try {
				// Skip empty/pad rows
				String rowClass = row.getAttribute("class");
				if (rowClass != null && rowClass.contains("-padRow")) {
					continue;
				}
				// Col 2: Category, Col 3: Description, Col 4: Date posted
				String actualCategory = row.findElement(By.cssSelector(".rt-td:nth-child(2)")).getText().trim();
				String actualDescription = row.findElement(By.cssSelector(".rt-td:nth-child(3)")).getText().trim();
				String actualDate = row.findElement(By.cssSelector(".rt-td:nth-child(4)")).getText().trim();
				if (actualDescription.isEmpty()) {
					continue;
				}
				if (actualDate.equalsIgnoreCase(todayDisplayDate)) {
					for (DocumentKey key : keysToWatch) {
						boolean descMatches = key.description.equalsIgnoreCase(actualDescription);
						boolean catMatches = key.category.isEmpty() || key.category.equalsIgnoreCase(actualCategory);
						if (descMatches && catMatches) {
							counts.put(key, counts.get(key) + 1);
							break; // Each row matches at most one key
						}
					}
				}
			} catch (NoSuchElementException ignored) {
				// Row empty or temporarily detached
			}
		}
	}
	/**
	 * Checks if the Jut "Next" button is present and not disabled.
	 */
	private boolean hasNextPage() {
		try {
			List<WebElement> nextButtons = getDriver().findElements(By.xpath(
					"//div[contains(@class, 'jut__Pagination__paginationNav')]//button[.//span[text()='Next']]"
			));
			if (nextButtons.isEmpty()) {
				return false;
			}
			WebElement nextBtn = nextButtons.get(0);
			String btnClass = nextBtn.getAttribute("class");
			String disabledAttr = nextBtn.getAttribute("disabled");
			String ariaDisabled = nextBtn.getAttribute("aria-disabled");
			boolean isDisabled = disabledAttr != null
					|| "true".equalsIgnoreCase(ariaDisabled)
					|| (btnClass != null && btnClass.toLowerCase().contains("disabled"));
			return nextBtn.isDisplayed() && !isDisabled;
		} catch (Exception e) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	/**
	 * Clicks the Jut "Next" button.
	 */
	private void goToNextPage() {
		try {
			WebElement nextBtn = getDriver().findElement(By.xpath(
					"//div[contains(@class, 'jut__Pagination__paginationNav')]//button[.//span[text()='Next']]"
			));
			nextBtn.click();
		} catch (Exception e) {
			System.err.println("Warning: Failed to click Next page: " + e.getMessage());
		}
	}
	/**

	 */
	private void resetToFirstPage() {
		try {
			List<WebElement> page1Buttons = getDriver().findElements(By.xpath(
					"//div[contains(@class, 'jut__Pagination__pageButtonsWrapper')]//button[.//span[text()='1']]"
			));
			if (!page1Buttons.isEmpty()) {
				WebElement page1Btn = page1Buttons.get(0);
				String btnClass = page1Btn.getAttribute("class");
				if (btnClass == null || !btnClass.contains("jut__Pagination__selectedPageButton")) {
					page1Btn.click();
					Sleep(800);
				}
			}
		} catch (Exception e) {
			System.err.println("Warning: Unable to reset to Page 1: " + e.getMessage());
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Helper to expand and apply search filters.
	 */
	private void applySearchFilters(String category, String description, String filterDate) {
		try {
			if (isDisplayed(SearchOptionExpand)) {
				Click(SearchOptionExpand);
			}
			// 1. Only select Category if uniform across all files
			if (category != null && !category.trim().isEmpty()) {
				Select(DocumentCategoryFilter, category.trim());
			}
			// 2. Only enter Description if uniform across all files
			if (description != null && !description.trim().isEmpty()) {
				Enter(DocumentDescriptionFilter, description.trim());
			}
			// 3. Always enter today's date in From & To to reduce noise
			if (isDisplayed(PostedDateFromFilter)) {
				Enter(PostedDateFromFilter, filterDate);
			}
			if (isDisplayed(PostedDateToFilter)) {
				Enter(PostedDateToFilter, filterDate);
			}
			// 4. Click Search
			Click(SearchButtonFilter);
			Sleep(1500);
			// 5. Expand page size to 'Show All' if available
			selectShowAllPageSize();
		} catch (Exception e) {
			System.err.println("Warning: Error applying search filters: " + e.getMessage());
		}
	}
	/**
	 * Key representation of an expected document (Description + Category).
	 * Implements case-insensitive equals and hashCode for tracking in Maps/Sets.
	 */
	private static class DocumentKey {
		final String description;
		final String category;
		DocumentKey(String description, String category) {
			this.description = description != null ? description.trim() : "";
			this.category = category != null ? category.trim() : "";
		}
		@Override
		public boolean equals(Object o) {
			if (this == o) return true;
			if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
			DocumentKey that = (DocumentKey) o;
			return description.equalsIgnoreCase(that.description) &&
					category.equalsIgnoreCase(that.category);
		}
		@Override
		public int hashCode() {
			return Objects.hash(description.toLowerCase(), category.toLowerCase());
		}
		@Override
		public String toString() {
			return "[" + description + " (" + (category.isEmpty() ? "Any Category" : category) + ")]";
		}
	}
	/**
	 * Deletes the temporary files created during the upload process.
	 */
	private void cleanupUploadedFiles(String filenamesString) {
		Arrays.stream(filenamesString.split(","))
				.map(String::trim)
				.forEach(filename -> {
					try {
						Files.deleteIfExists(Paths.get("src/test/resources/DocUploadFiles", filename));
						System.out.println("Deleted temporary file: " + filename);
					} catch (IOException e) {
						System.err.println("Could not delete temporary file: " + filename + ". Error: " + e.getMessage());
					}
				});
	}

	public boolean selectNonWSIBForm(String nonwsibformtype, String nonwsibform) {
		List<String> categories = Arrays.stream(nonwsibformtype.split("\\|"))
				.map(String::trim)
				.collect(Collectors.toList());
		List<String> documents = Arrays.stream(nonwsibform.split("\\|"))
				.map(String::trim)
				.collect(Collectors.toList());

		List<WebElement> fileItemContainers = wait.until(ExpectedConditions.presenceOfAllElementsLocatedBy(By.cssSelector(".fileItemContainer")));

		if (fileItemContainers.size() != categories.size() || fileItemContainers.size() != documents.size()) {
			throw new AssertionError("Mismatch between number of uploaded files and Non-WSIB form selections provided.");
		}

		for (int i = 0; i < fileItemContainers.size(); i++) {
			WebElement currentFileContainer = fileItemContainers.get(i);
			String currentCategory = categories.get(i);
			String currentDocument = documents.get(i);

			String radioGroupId = "docSource" + i;
			WebElement noRadioButton = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.id(radioGroupId + "_no"));

			// Select "No" for "Is this a WSIB form?"
			if (!noRadioButton.isSelected()) {
				Click(noRadioButton);
				System.out.println("Selected 'No' for file at index " + i);
			}

			// Select Category dropdown (Dropdown 1)
			WebElement categoryDropdown = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.xpath(".//*[contains(@id, 'formcategoryselection-wrapper')]"));
			Select(categoryDropdown, currentCategory);
			System.out.println("Selected Category: '" + currentCategory + "' for file index " + i);

			// Select Document type dropdown (Dropdown 2)
			WebElement docTypeDropdown = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.xpath(".//*[contains(@id, 'nonwsibformselection-wrapper')]"));
			Select(docTypeDropdown, currentDocument);
			System.out.println("Selected Document Name: '" + currentDocument + "' for file index " + i);
		}
		return true;
	}

	public boolean updateMailingAddress() {
		int size = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("Address Line1").split("-").length;
		String addressline1 = generateRandomNumber(3)+"-"+ Hooks.currentRow.get().get("Address Line1").split("-")[size-1];
		String city = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("City");
		String province = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("Province");
		String postalcode = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("Postal Code");
		String country = Hooks.currentRow.get().get("Country");
		waitUntilElementVisible(inputAddressLine1);
		Enter(inputAddressLine1, addressline1);
		Enter(inputCity, city);
		//selectDropdownValue(dropdownProvince, province);
		Enter(inputPostalCode, postalcode);
		//selectDropdownValue(dropdownCountry, country);
		Assert.assertTrue(dropdownCountry.getText().contains(country));
		
		scrollToElement(AddressCheckbox);
		Click(AddressCheckbox);
		
		scrollToElement(addressSubmitButton);
		try {
			Click(addressSubmitButton);
		} catch (Exception e) {
			jsClick(addressSubmitButton);
		}

		try {
			waitUntilElementVisible(successfulbannerCotainerInfo);
		} catch (TimeoutException e) {
			// If banner doesn't appear, check if we're still on the input screen (implies error)
			if (isDisplayed(inputAddressLine1)) {
				Hooks.log("Mailing Address update failed. Successful banner did not appear.");
				return false;
			}
		}

		// Update the current row data with the new values
		Map<String, String> currentRowData = Hooks.currentRow.get();
		currentRowData.put("Address Line1", addressline1);

		String sheetName = Hooks.sheetName.get();
		JsonUtils.writeJsonData(sheetName, Hooks.data.get());
		Hooks.currentRow.set(currentRowData);

		String provinceAbbreviation = province; // Default to the full name if no match is found

// Map of province names to their abbreviations
		Map<String, String> provinceMap = new HashMap<>();
		provinceMap.put("Alberta", "AB");
		provinceMap.put("British Columbia", "BC");
		provinceMap.put("Manitoba", "MB");
		provinceMap.put("New Brunswick", "NB");
		provinceMap.put("Newfoundland and Labrador", "NL");
		provinceMap.put("Nova Scotia", "NS");
		provinceMap.put("Ontario", "ON");
		provinceMap.put("Prince Edward Island", "PE");
		provinceMap.put("Quebec", "QC");
		provinceMap.put("Saskatchewan", "SK");
		provinceMap.put("Northwest Territories", "NT");
		provinceMap.put("Nunavut", "NU");
		provinceMap.put("Yukon", "YT");

// Get the abbreviation for the province
		if (provinceMap.containsKey(province)) {
			provinceAbbreviation = provinceMap.get(province);
		}
		Sleep(3000);
		// Normalize strings by trimming and replacing multiple whitespace/newlines with a single space
		String expectedAddress = (addressline1 + ", " + city + ", " + provinceAbbreviation + " " + postalcode).trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
		String actualAddress = addressPlaceholder.getText().trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");


		if(expectedAddress.equalsIgnoreCase(actualAddress)) {
			Hooks.log("Mailing address updated successfully in the application.");
			return true;
		} else {
			Hooks.log("Mailing address update failed in the application.");
			Hooks.log("Address Expected: [" + expectedAddress + "]");
			Hooks.log("Address Actual  : [" + actualAddress + "]");
			return false;
		}

	}

			// Update the current row data with the phone number
			Map<String, String> currentRowData = Hooks.currentRow.get();
			currentRowData.put("QPhoneNumber", phoneNumber);
			phoneNumber = phoneNumber.substring(0,3)+"-"+phoneNumber.substring(3,6)+"-"+phoneNumber.substring(6);
			currentRowData.put("Phone Number", phoneNumber);


			String sheetName = Hooks.sheetName.get();
			JsonUtils.writeJsonData(sheetName, Hooks.data.get());
			Hooks.currentRow.set(currentRowData);

		} catch (TimeoutException e) {
			if (isDisplayed(inputPhoneNumber)) {
				Hooks.log("Phone Number update failed. Successful banner did not appear.");
				return false;
			}
		}
		Sleep(4000);


		String actualPhone = phonePlaceholder.getText().trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
		if(actualPhone.contains(phoneNumber)) {
			Hooks.log("Phone number updated successfully in the application.");
			return true;
		} else {
			Hooks.log("Phone number update failed in the application.");
			return false;
		}
	}
}

package pages.UNCD;

import definitions.Hooks;
import org.openqa.selenium.By;

	public List<String> uploadDocument(String filenamesString) throws IOException {
		List<String> originalFilenames = Arrays.stream(filenamesString.split(","))
				.map(String::trim)
				.collect(Collectors.toList());

		List<String> timestampedAbsolutePaths = new ArrayList<>();
		List<String> timestampedFilenames = new ArrayList<>();

		// Generate a unique timestamp for the batch
		String timestamp = LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd_HHmmssSSS"));

		for (int i = 0; i < originalFilenames.size(); i++) {
			String originalFilename = originalFilenames.get(i);
			Path originalFilePath = Paths.get("src/test/resources/DocUploadFiles", originalFilename);

			// Extract filename without extension and its extension
			String fileNameWithoutExtension = originalFilename.substring(0, originalFilename.lastIndexOf('.'));
			String fileExtension = originalFilename.substring(originalFilename.lastIndexOf('.'));

			// Create new filename with timestamp and index to ensure uniqueness within the batch
			String newFilename = fileNameWithoutExtension + "_" + timestamp + "_" + i + fileExtension;
			Path newFilePath = Paths.get("src/test/resources/DocUploadFiles", newFilename);

			// Copy the original file to the new timestamped file path, overwriting if exists
			Files.copy(originalFilePath, newFilePath, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
			System.out.println("Copied original file '" + originalFilename + "' to '" + newFilename + "'");

			timestampedAbsolutePaths.add(newFilePath.toAbsolutePath().toString());
			timestampedFilenames.add(newFilename);
		}

		WebElement input = getDriver().findElement(By.cssSelector("input[type='file']"));
		((JavascriptExecutor) getDriver()).executeScript("arguments[0].style.display = 'block';", input);

		// Join the timestamped absolute paths with newline characters for multiple file upload
		String filePaths = String.join("\n", timestampedAbsolutePaths);
		input.sendKeys(filePaths);

		waitUntilElementVisible(isthisaWSIBform);
		// Return the list of timestamped filenames for further use (e.g., updating GWCC.json)
		return timestampedFilenames;
	}

	public Boolean selectWSIBForm(String wsibFormsString) {
		List<String> wsibFormSelections = Arrays.stream(wsibFormsString.split("\\|"))
				.map(String::trim)
				.collect(Collectors.toList());

		// Find all the file item containers.
		// This assumes the order of these containers in the DOM matches the order of files uploaded.
		List<WebElement> fileItemContainers = wait.until(ExpectedConditions.presenceOfAllElementsLocatedBy(By.cssSelector(".MuiGrid-root.MuiGrid-container.MuiGrid-direction-xs-row.css-akeo4y")));

		if (fileItemContainers.size() != wsibFormSelections.size()) {
			throw new AssertionError("Mismatch between number of uploaded files and WSIB form selections provided in test data.");
		}

		for (int i = 0; i < fileItemContainers.size(); i++) {
			String currentWsibFormSelection = wsibFormSelections.get(i);
			WebElement currentFileContainer = fileItemContainers.get(i);

			// Construct the ID for the radio button group based on its index
			String radioGroupId = "formtype" + i;

			// Locate the "Yes" and "No" radio buttons within the current file's container
			WebElement yesRadioButton = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.xpath(".//*[@aria-labelledby='" + radioGroupId + "']/label/span/input[@value='yes']"));
			WebElement noRadioButton = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.xpath(".//*[@aria-labelledby='" + radioGroupId + "']/label/span/input[@value='no']"));

			// Determine whether to select "Yes" or "No"
			// We consider it a WSIB form if the selection string is not empty, "No", or "N/A"
			if (!currentWsibFormSelection.isEmpty() &&
					!currentWsibFormSelection.equalsIgnoreCase("No") &&
					!currentWsibFormSelection.equalsIgnoreCase("N/A")) {

				// Select "Yes"
				if (!yesRadioButton.isSelected()) {
					Click(yesRadioButton);
					System.out.println("Selected 'Yes' for file at index " + i + " (WSIB Form: " + currentWsibFormSelection + ")");
				}

                WebElement wsibFormTypeDropdown = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.xpath(".//*[@id='edobformselection" + i + "-select']"));
                Select(wsibFormTypeDropdown, currentWsibFormSelection);
                System.out.println("Selected WSIB form type: " + currentWsibFormSelection);


			} else {
				// Select "No"
				if (!noRadioButton.isSelected()) {
					Click(noRadioButton);
					System.out.println("Selected 'No' for file at index " + i);
				}
			}
		}
		Click(NextButton);
		try{
			if(alertdialogtitle.isDisplayed()){
				System.out.println("Alert dialog displayed");
				Click(alertCloseButton);
				Sleep(5000);
				Click(NextButton);
			}
		}
		catch(Exception e){
			System.out.println("Alert dialog not displayed");
		}
      return true;
    }

	public boolean selectNonWSIBForm(String nonwsibformtype, String nonwsibform) {
		List<String> categories = Arrays.stream(nonwsibformtype.split("\\|"))
				.map(String::trim)
				.collect(Collectors.toList());
		List<String> documents = Arrays.stream(nonwsibform.split("\\|"))
				.map(String::trim)
				.collect(Collectors.toList());

		List<WebElement> fileItemContainers = wait.until(ExpectedConditions.presenceOfAllElementsLocatedBy(By.cssSelector(".MuiGrid-root.MuiGrid-container.MuiGrid-direction-xs-row.css-akeo4y")));

		if (fileItemContainers.size() != categories.size() || fileItemContainers.size() != documents.size()) {
			throw new AssertionError("Mismatch between number of uploaded files and Non-WSIB form selections provided.");
		}

		for (int i = 0; i < fileItemContainers.size(); i++) {
			WebElement currentFileContainer = fileItemContainers.get(i);
			String currentCategory = categories.get(i);
			String currentDocument = documents.get(i);

			String radioGroupId = "formtype" + i;
			WebElement noRadioButton = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.xpath(".//*[@aria-labelledby='" + radioGroupId + "']/label/span/input[@value='no']"));

			// Select "No" for "Is this a WSIB form?"
			if (!noRadioButton.isSelected()) {
				Click(noRadioButton);
				System.out.println("Selected 'No' for file at index " + i);
			}

			// Select Category dropdown (Dropdown 1)
			WebElement categoryDropdown = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.xpath(".//*[@id='catogoryselection" + i + "-select']"));
			Select(categoryDropdown, currentCategory);
			System.out.println("Selected Category: '" + currentCategory + "' for file index " + i);

			// Select Document type dropdown (Dropdown 2)
			WebElement docTypeDropdown = currentFileContainer.findElement(By.xpath(".//*[@id='subformselection" + i + "-select']"));
			Select(docTypeDropdown, currentDocument);
			System.out.println("Selected Document Name: '" + currentDocument + "' for file index " + i);
		}
		Click(NextButton);
		try{
			if(alertdialogtitle.isDisplayed()){
				System.out.println("Alert dialog displayed");
				Click(alertCloseButton);
				Sleep(5000);
				Click(NextButton);
			}
		}
		catch(Exception e){
			System.out.println("Alert dialog not displayed");
		}
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Deletes the temporary files created during the upload process.
	 */
	public void cleanupUploadedFiles(String filenamesString) { // Changed to public
		Arrays.stream(filenamesString.split(","))
				.map(String::trim)
				.forEach(filename -> {
					try {
						Files.deleteIfExists(Paths.get("src/test/resources/DocUploadFiles", filename));
						Hooks.log("Deleted temporary file: " + filename);
					} catch (IOException e) {
						System.err.println("Could not delete temporary file: " + filename + ". Error: " + e.getMessage());
					}
				});
	}

		}

package testRunner;

import io.cucumber.testng.AbstractTestNGCucumberTests;
import io.cucumber.testng.CucumberOptions;
import org.testng.annotations.DataProvider;
import org.testng.annotations.Listeners;
import org.testng.annotations.BeforeSuite;

import utils.ExtentReportListener;
import utils.ExtentTestNameListener;
import utils.RetryInvokedListener;

    }

                    }
                } else {
                    multipliedScenarios.add(scenario);
                }
            } else {
                multipliedScenarios.add(scenario);
            }
        }

package utils;

import com.deque.html.axecore.results.Results;
import com.deque.html.axecore.results.Rule;
import com.deque.html.axecore.selenium.AxeBuilder;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;

import java.util.List;

public class AccessibilityUtils {

    /**
     * Runs a full WCAG accessibility scan on the current page.
     * Tags: wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21aa cover WCAG 2.0/2.1 Level A & AA.
     *
     * @param driver   active WebDriver instance
     * @param pageName a label for reporting purposes
     * @return AxeResults containing violations, passes, incomplete
     */
    public static Results runAccessibilityScan(WebDriver driver, String pageName) {
        Results axeResults = new AxeBuilder()
                .withTags(List.of("wcag2a", "wcag2aa", "wcag21aa", "wcag22aa", "best-practice"))
                .analyze(driver);

        System.out.println("=== Accessibility Scan: " + pageName + " ===");
        System.out.println("URL: " + axeResults.getUrl());
        System.out.println("WCAG Violations Found: " + axeResults.getViolations().size());

        return axeResults;
    }

    /**
     * Builds a human-readable summary of violations for reporting.
     */
    public static String buildViolationSummary(Results results) {
        List<Rule> violations = results.getViolations();
        if (violations.isEmpty()) {
            return "âœ… No WCAG violations found on: " + results.getUrl();
        }

        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("âŒ WCAG Violations on: ").append(results.getUrl()).append("\n\n");

        for (Rule violation : violations) {
            sb.append("--------------------------------------------------\n");
            sb.append("Rule ID    : ").append(violation.getId()).append("\n");
            sb.append("Impact     : ").append(violation.getImpact()).append("\n");
            sb.append("Description: ").append(violation.getDescription()).append("\n");
            sb.append("Help URL   : ").append(violation.getHelpUrl()).append("\n");
            sb.append("Affected Nodes:\n");
            violation.getNodes().forEach(node -> {
                sb.append("  - HTML  : ").append(node.getHtml()).append("\n");
                node.getFailureSummary().lines().forEach(line ->
                        sb.append("    Issue : ").append(line.trim()).append("\n")
                );
            });
            sb.append("\n");
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /**
     * Returns true if there are any critical/serious violations.
     */
    public static boolean hasCriticalViolations(Results results) {
        return results.getViolations().stream()
                .anyMatch(v -> "critical".equals(v.getImpact()) || "serious".equals(v.getImpact()));
    }

    public static String getProvinceAbbreviation(String province) {
        return switch (province.toLowerCase()) {
            case "alberta" -> "AB";
            case "british columbia" -> "BC";
            case "manitoba" -> "MB";
            case "new brunswick" -> "NB";
            case "newfoundland and labrador" -> "NL";

    protected void waitUntilElementVisible(WebElement element) {
        try {
            wait.until(ExpectedConditions.visibilityOf(element));
        } catch (StaleElementReferenceException e) {
            // If the element is stale, accessing it again (if it's a PageFactory element) might re-find it.
            // However, this is still risky. A better way is to use By locators.
            try {
                wait.until(ExpectedConditions.visibilityOf(element));
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                System.out.println("Failed to wait for element even after retry: " + ex.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Robust wait that uses a By locator to find and wait for an element.
     * This is much more resistant to StaleElementReferenceException.
     */
    protected WebElement waitUntilElementVisible(By locator) {
        return wait.until(ExpectedConditions.visibilityOfElementLocated(locator));
    }

    public static String getCurrentDate(String format)
    {
        // Changed from LocalDate to LocalDateTime to support time-based formatting
        LocalDateTime currentDateTime = LocalDateTime.now();
        DateTimeFormatter formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(format);
        return currentDateTime.format(formatter);
    }


    public static String getDateFormat(String inputDate, String inFormat, String outFormat)
    {
        SimpleDateFormat inputFormat = new SimpleDateFormat(inFormat);
        SimpleDateFormat outputFormat = new SimpleDateFormat(outFormat);
        String formattedDate = "";
        try {
            Date date = inputFormat.parse(inputDate);
            formattedDate = outputFormat.format(date);
            System.out.println("Formatted Date: " + formattedDate);
        } catch (ParseException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return formattedDate;
    }


    public static String convertDate(String inputDate, String outputFormat) {
        if (inputDate == null || outputFormat == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Date and output format must not be null.");
        }
        String[] inputFormats = {
                "uuuu-MM-dd",
                "uuuu/MM/dd",
                "dd/MM/uuuu",
                "MM/dd/uuuu",
                "dd-MM-uuuu",
                "MM-dd-uuuu",
                "dd.MM.uuuu",
                "d MMM uuuu",
                "d MMMM uuuu",
                "MMM d, uuuu",
                "MMMM d, uuuu"
        };
        DateTimeFormatter outputFormatter =
                DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(outputFormat, Locale.ENGLISH);
        for (String pattern : inputFormats) {
            DateTimeFormatter inputFormatter =
                    DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(pattern, Locale.ENGLISH)
                            .withResolverStyle(ResolverStyle.STRICT);
            try {
                LocalDate date =
                        LocalDate.parse(inputDate.trim(), inputFormatter);
                return date.format(outputFormatter);
            } catch (DateTimeParseException ignored) {
                // Try the next input format.
            }
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Invalid or unsupported date: " + inputDate);
    }

    public static String generateRandomText(int length) {
        int leftLimit = 97; // 'a'
        int rightLimit = 122; // 'z'
        Random random = new Random();
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(length);
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            int randomChar = leftLimit + (int) (random.nextFloat() * (rightLimit - leftLimit + 1));
            builder.append((char) randomChar);
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static String generateRandomNumber(int length) {
        int leftLimit = 48; // '0'
        int rightLimit = 57; // '9'
        Random random = new Random();
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(length);
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            int randomChar = leftLimit + (int) (random.nextFloat() * (rightLimit - leftLimit + 1));
            builder.append((char) randomChar);
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }

    // New robust click utility that tries multiple methods
    protected void Click(WebElement element) {
        int attempts = 0;
        boolean success = false;
        Exception lastException = null;
        while (attempts < 3) {
            try {
                // 1. Wait for element visibility & clickability (PageFactory re-locates on every call)
                WebDriverWait wait = new WebDriverWait(driver, Duration.ofSeconds(10));
                wait.ignoring(StaleElementReferenceException.class);
                wait.until(ExpectedConditions.elementToBeClickable(element));
                // 2. Scroll element into center view to avoid header/footer/scrollbar interception
                try {
                    ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript(
                            "arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block: 'center', inline: 'nearest'});",
                            element
                    );
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                // 3. Try standard Selenium click
                element.click();
                success = true;
                break;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                lastException = e;
                System.out.println("Standard click failed (attempt " + (attempts + 1) + "): " + e.getMessage());
                // 4. Fallback 1: JavaScript Click
                try {
                    ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("arguments[0].click();", element);
                    success = true;
                    break;
                } catch (Exception jsEx) {
                    lastException = jsEx;
                    System.out.println("JS click failed: " + jsEx.getMessage());
                    // 5. Fallback 2: Actions moveToElement + Click
                    try {
                        Actions actions = new Actions(driver);
                        actions.moveToElement(element).pause(Duration.ofMillis(200)).click().perform();
                        success = true;
                        break;
                    } catch (Exception actEx) {
                        lastException = actEx;
                        System.out.println("Actions click failed: " + actEx.getMessage());
                        // 6. Fallback 3: Guidewire native event trigger (mouse event dispatch)
                        try {
                            String gwClickScript =
                                    "var evt = new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window});" +
                                            "arguments[0].dispatchEvent(evt);";
                            ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript(gwClickScript, element);
                            success = true;
                            break;
                        } catch (Exception dispatchEx) {
                            lastException = dispatchEx;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            attempts++;
            try {
                Thread.sleep(1000); // Allow DOM / Guidewire table to settle before retry
            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}
        }
        if (!success) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to click element after 3 attempts. Last error: "
                    + (lastException != null ? lastException.getMessage() : "Unknown"), lastException);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Selects an option from a Guidewire Jutro / React-Select dropdown field.
     *
     * @param dropdownId e.g., "dropdownEmploymentType" or "dropdownEmploymentType-wrapper"
     * @param optionText The exact visible text of the option to select (e.g. "Full-time", "Part-time")
     */
    public void selectJutroDropdownOption(String dropdownId, String optionText) {
        WebDriverWait wait = new WebDriverWait(getDriver(), Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        // Normalize ID in case wrapper or input ID is passed
        String wrapperId = dropdownId.endsWith("-wrapper") ? dropdownId : dropdownId + "-wrapper";
        // 1. Locate and click the dropdown control to open the menu
        By dropdownControlLocator = By.xpath(
                "//*[@id='" + wrapperId + "' or @id='" + dropdownId + "']" +
                        "//div[contains(@class, 'jut__GenericSelectControl__control')]"
        );
        WebElement dropdownControl = wait.until(ExpectedConditions.elementToBeClickable(dropdownControlLocator));
        // Scroll into view & click to expand
        ((JavascriptExecutor) getDriver()).executeScript("arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block: 'center'});", dropdownControl);
        dropdownControl.click();
        // 2. Locate the option from the opened Jutro menu listbox
        By optionLocator = By.xpath(
                "//div[contains(@class, 'jut__GenericSelectControl__menu') or contains(@class, 'jut__DropdownSelectField__menu')]" +
                        "//div[contains(@class, 'jut__GenericSelectControl__option') or @role='option'][normalize-space(.)='" + optionText + "']"
        );
        try {
            WebElement optionElement = wait.until(ExpectedConditions.visibilityOfElementLocated(optionLocator));
            wait.until(ExpectedConditions.elementToBeClickable(optionElement));
            optionElement.click();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Fallback: If option is outside visible menu area, scroll inside menu or try broad text match
            By fallbackOptionLocator = By.xpath(
                    "//div[contains(@class, 'jut__GenericSelectControl__menu')]//*[normalize-space(text())='" + optionText + "']"
            );
            WebElement fallbackOption = wait.until(ExpectedConditions.presenceOfElementLocated(fallbackOptionLocator));
            ((JavascriptExecutor) getDriver()).executeScript("arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block: 'nearest'});", fallbackOption);
            ((JavascriptExecutor) getDriver()).executeScript("arguments[0].click();", fallbackOption);
        }
    }

    // Robust sendKeys utility that supports Standard, Angular, Masked, and Google Places Autocomplete fields
    protected void Enter(WebElement element, String value) {
        if (element == null || value == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("WebElement and value cannot be null");
        }

        int attempts = 0;
        boolean success = false;
        Keys controlKey = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase().contains("mac") ? Keys.COMMAND : Keys.CONTROL;

        while (attempts < 3) {
            try {
                waitUntilElementVisible(element);
                String classAttr = element.getAttribute("class");
                boolean isMaskedField = classAttr != null && classAttr.contains("InputMaskField");
                boolean isGooglePlaces = classAttr != null && classAttr.contains("pac-target-input");

                String textToSend = value;
                if (isMaskedField && value.matches(".*\\d.*")) {
                    textToSend = value.replaceAll("[^0-9a-zA-Z]", "");
                }

                // ==========================================
                // OPTION 1: Standard Clear & SendKeys
                // ==========================================
                try {
                    element.click();
                    element.sendKeys(Keys.chord(controlKey, "a"), Keys.BACK_SPACE);
                    element.sendKeys(textToSend);

                    if (isGooglePlaces) {
                        Sleep(500);
                        element.sendKeys(Keys.ARROW_DOWN, Keys.ENTER);
                    } else {
                        element.sendKeys(Keys.TAB); // Preserves standard blur/validation for regular apps
                    }

                    if (isInputValuePopulated(element)) {
                        success = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    System.out.println("Option 1 failed: " + e.getMessage());
                }

                // ==========================================
                // OPTION 2: Slow Typing
                // ==========================================
                try {
                    System.out.println("Trying Option 2 (Slow Keystroke typing)...");
                    element.click();
                    element.sendKeys(Keys.chord(controlKey, "a"), Keys.BACK_SPACE);
                    for (char ch : textToSend.toCharArray()) {
                        element.sendKeys(String.valueOf(ch));
                        Sleep(40);
                    }

                    if (isGooglePlaces) {
                        Sleep(500);
                        element.sendKeys(Keys.ARROW_DOWN, Keys.ENTER);
                    } else {
                        element.sendKeys(Keys.TAB);
                    }

                    if (isInputValuePopulated(element)) {
                        success = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    System.out.println("Option 2 failed: " + e.getMessage());
                }

                // ==========================================
                // OPTION 3: Universal JS Setter (Angular + React + Standard)
                // ==========================================
                try {
                    System.out.println("Trying Option 3 (Universal JS fallback)...");
                    setUniversalInputValueJs(element, textToSend, isGooglePlaces);
                    if (isInputValuePopulated(element)) {
                        success = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    System.out.println("Option 3 failed: " + e.getMessage());
                }

                attempts++;
                Sleep(500);
            } catch (StaleElementReferenceException e) {
                attempts++;
                Sleep(500);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                attempts++;
                Sleep(500);
            }
        }

        if (!success) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to enter value '" + value + "' after 3 attempts.");
        }
    }

    private void setUniversalInputValueJs(WebElement element, String value, boolean isGooglePlaces) {
        JavascriptExecutor js = (JavascriptExecutor) driver;
        // Dispatches events for Angular & React, only blurs if not an autocomplete field
        String script =
                "var input = arguments[0];" +
                        "var val = arguments[1];" +
                        "var isGooglePlaces = arguments[2];" +
                        "input.focus();" +
                        "var setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value');" +
                        "if (setter && setter.set) { setter.set.call(input, val); } else { input.value = val; }" +
                        "input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));" +
                        "input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));" +
                        "if (!isGooglePlaces) { input.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur', { bubbles: true })); }";
        js.executeScript(script, element, value, isGooglePlaces);
    }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    // Utility to select partial value from the dropdown with retry and JS fallback
    protected boolean Select(WebElement element, String value) {
        int attempts = 0;
        boolean isSelected = false;

        while (attempts < 3) {
            try {
                System.out.println("Attempting to select '" + value + "'. Attempt: " + (attempts + 1));

                // 1. Click the dropdown to open it
                try {
                    element.click();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    System.out.println("Standard click on dropdown failed, trying JS click...");
                    jsClick(element);
                }
                Sleep(1000); // Wait for dropdown to open

                // 2. Locate the option element
                // Use a shorter wait for finding the option, as the dropdown should be open
                String dynamicXPath = "//*[contains(text(),'" + value + "')]";
                WebElement optionElement = new WebDriverWait(getDriver(), Duration.ofSeconds(5))
                        .until(ExpectedConditions.presenceOfElementLocated(By.xpath(dynamicXPath)));

                // 3. Try standard click on option first, then JS fallback
                try {
                    optionElement.click();
                } catch (Exception clickEx) {
                    System.out.println("Standard click on option failed, trying JS click...");
                    jsClick(optionElement);
                }

               Sleep(1000); // Wait for selection to process

                // 4. Verification: Check if the displayed text matches the expected value
                // or if the element's 'value' attribute contains the expected value
                String actualText = element.getText();
                if (actualText.contains(value) || isSelectedViaAttribute(element, value)) {
                    System.out.println("Successfully selected: " + value);
                    isSelected = true;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                System.out.println("Exception during selection attempt " + (attempts + 1) + ": " + e.getMessage());
            }
            attempts++;
        }

        if (!isSelected) {
            System.err.println("Failed to select '" + value + "' after 3 attempts.");
        }
        return isSelected;
    }

    /**
     * Specialized select for standard HTML <select> tags, typically used in Guidewire ClaimCenter.
     * Uses the Selenium Select class with retry logic.
     */
    protected boolean GWSelect(WebElement element, String value) {
        int attempts = 0;
        boolean isSelected = false;

        while (attempts < 3) {
            try {
                System.out.println("Attempting Select for '" + value + "'. Attempt: " + (attempts + 1));
                
                // Wait for element to be visible
                waitUntilElementVisible(element);
                
                Select select = new Select(element);
                
                // Try selecting by visible text (common for Guidewire)
                try {
                    select.selectByVisibleText(value);
                } catch (NoSuchElementException e) {
                    // Fallback to partial text match if exact match fails
                    System.out.println("Exact visible text match failed, trying partial match...");
                    boolean partialFound = false;
                    for (WebElement option : select.getOptions()) {
                        if (option.getText().toLowerCase().contains(value.toLowerCase())) {
                            select.selectByVisibleText(option.getText());
                            partialFound = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!partialFound) throw e;
                }

                isSelected = true;
                System.out.println("Successfully selected in : " + value);
                break;
            } catch (StaleElementReferenceException e) {
                System.out.println("Stale element during Select, retrying...");
            } catch (Exception e) {
                System.out.println( "Select failed on attempt " + (attempts + 1) + ": " + e.getMessage());
            }
            attempts++;
            Sleep(1000);
        }

        if (!isSelected) {
            System.err.println("Failed to select '" + value + "' after 3 attempts.");
        }
        return isSelected;
    }

    // Helper to check if value is selected via attribute (common in Guidewire)
    private boolean isSelectedViaAttribute(WebElement element, String value) {
        try {
            // This is typically for <select> elements where the 'value' attribute of the <select>
            // itself changes, or for input fields that get populated.
            String val = element.getAttribute("value");
            return val != null && val.contains(value);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
